items.title: 8月五大銀行新承做房貸月減近120億元 創3個月低
items.title_en: August Five Major Banks' New Mortgage Origination Down Nearly 120 Billion, Lowest in Three Months
paras: 台灣央行今(22)日公布8月五大銀行新承做房貸金額為571.65億元，月減119.44億元，並來到3個月來低點，而房貸利率則較上月彈升0.031個百分點至2.321%，創3個月來高。
央行說明，房貸承作額降低主要逢農曆7月影響市場部分交易量、颱風因素干擾銀行核貸作業並影響民眾看屋意願等，再加上新青安3.0上路所致。
由於利率相對較低的新青安房貸承做下滑，占房貸比重降至41.88%，創10個月來低點，也使房貸利率反彈。
整體來看，央行統計8月本國五大銀行(台銀、合庫銀、一銀、華銀及土銀)新承做放款加權平均利率為2.187%，月升0.020個百分點，儘管資本支出貸款利率下降，其餘各類貸款利率均上升。
而8月五大銀行不含國庫借款的新承做放款加權平均利率同為2.187%，月增0.02個百分點。
paras_en: The Central Bank of Taiwan announced today (22nd) that the amount of new mortgage loans originated by the five major banks in August was NT$571.65 billion, a monthly decrease of NT$119.44 billion, reaching the lowest level in three months, while the mortgage rate rose by 0.031 percentage points from the previous month to 2.321%, the highest in three months.

The central bank explained that the drop in mortgage origination was mainly due to the lunar July effect reducing market transaction volume, typhoon disruptions to banks' loan approval processes and dampening home‑viewing interest, as well as the rollout of the new “Qing‑An 3.0” program.

Because the relatively low‑rate Qing‑An mortgage saw a decline in origination, its share of total mortgages fell to 41.88%, the lowest in ten months, which also contributed to the rebound in mortgage rates.

Overall, the central bank’s statistics show that the weighted‑average rate of new loans issued by the five domestic banks (Bank of Taiwan, Cooperative Bank, First Bank, Hua Nan Bank and Land Bank) in August was 2.187%, up 0.020 percentage points month‑over‑month, even though the rate for capital‑expenditure loans fell while rates for all other loan categories rose.
The weighted‑average rate of new loans issued by the five major banks in August, excluding treasury borrowing, was also 2.187%, an increase of 0.02 percentage points from the previous month.

items.title: 鋼鐵公會：辦理輸歐盟鋼品出口配額管理 審核程序嚴謹並恪守公平、公正及保密原則
items.title_en: Taiwan Steel Association: Rigorous Review Process for EU Steel Export Quota Management Upholds Fairness, Impartiality, and Confidentiality
paras: 針對外界近期關注的「歐盟鋼鐵關稅配額管理及自由申請配額核配」一事，台灣鋼鐵工業同業公會今(22)日發出聲明表示，公會受經濟部國際貿易署委託辦理輸往歐盟鋼鐵產品放行前原產地證明書及加工證明書業務，相關配額管理均依主管機關公告之管理辦法及作業規範辦理，並秉持公平、公正及保密原則，配額比例則由貿易署核定，公會並未自行決定或調整。

鋼鐵公會指出，出口實績配額部分，是由貿易署依各廠商，包括貿易商，2022年至2024年平均出口量比例計算及分配後提供公會執行。至於因應歐盟新關稅配額措施所設立的「自由申請配額」，公會表示，主管機關今年6月依指示向鋼鐵業及出口業者進行意見調查，並綜合考量各類產品出口情況，同時參考2019年歐盟實施鋼鐵防衛措施期間的出口配額管理機制，研議並制定此次歐盟新關稅配額措施下的我國輸歐鋼品出口配額管理辦法，相關配額比例由貿易署核定。
鋼鐵公會說明，自由申請配額主要是協助過往沒有出口實績配額的新進鋼鐵製造商、出口實績配額較少的廠商及貿易商，或因應實際交易需求，提高國家配額使用效率，讓業者有機會爭取歐盟訂單。在申請資格方面，符合管理辦法規定的業者，包括出口實績配額已使用完畢，或獲配額度不足以履行單一交易的鋼鐵製造商及貿易商，均可提出申請；若業者未獲出口實績配額，則僅限鋼鐵製造商得免實績提出申請。
鋼鐵公會表示，申請業者須檢附申請書及與歐盟客戶簽訂的正式交易合約，公會審查時會逐項核對合約簽訂日、送貨目的地、預定出貨日及產品品項等條件，包括合約簽訂日須早於申請日、目的地須為歐盟地區、預定出貨日須於申請日後3個月內，且合約產品須精確符合申請類別，以確認申請具備實際出口需求。
此外，若申請量顯著超過業者歷年輸歐實績，或出現其他異常情形，公會也會再向申請廠商確認合約真實性及實際接單狀況，確認無誤後才納入當日核配計算。在核配方式上，鋼鐵公會指出，每一工作日收件截止後，若當日總申請量超過剩餘自由申請配額，將依各合格廠商申請量占當日合格總申請量的比例進行核配，數量核配完成後，再登錄至貿易署線上配額管理系統供業者查詢。
鋼鐵公會強調，配額管理系統設有權限控管機制，業者登入後僅能查詢自家公司獲配額度及該產品類別整體總額度，無法查詢其他業者的申請、獲配、放棄或轉讓額度等資訊，以確保業者商業機密及個資安全。
鋼鐵公會並表示，受貿易署委託辦理配額管理期間，將恪守保密義務，除依法令規定或主管機關要求外，不對外提供或揭露業者提交的交易合約、獲配額度及業務數據等個別商業機密與個資，並強調將持續依公平、公正及法遵原則，維護台灣鋼鐵產業出口秩序及整體產業權益。
paras_en: Regarding recent public attention on the EU steel tariff quota management and free application quota allocation, the Taiwan Steel Industry Association issued a statement on the 22nd stating that it has been commissioned by the Ministry of Economic Affairs’ International Trade Administration to handle certificates of origin and processing for steel products exported to the EU. All quota management follows the regulations and procedures announced by the competent authority, adheres to principles of fairness, impartiality and confidentiality, and the quota ratios are approved by the Trade Administration, not set or adjusted by the association itself.

The association explained that export performance quotas are calculated and allocated by the Trade Administration based on each company's, including traders’, average export volumes from 2022 to 2024, after which the association implements the allocations. In response to the EU’s new tariff quota measures, a “free application quota” was established. The authority conducted a survey of steel and export firms in June, considered export conditions of various products, and referenced the quota management mechanism used during the EU’s 2019 steel safeguard measures to draft the current quota management rules, with quota ratios again approved by the Trade Administration.

The free application quota is intended to help new steel manufacturers without export performance quotas, firms with limited export quotas, and traders, or to meet actual transaction needs and improve national quota utilization efficiency, giving them a chance to win EU orders. Eligible applicants—those whose export performance quota is exhausted or whose allocated quota is insufficient for a single transaction—may apply; if a firm has no export performance quota, only steel manufacturers may apply without performance proof.

Applicants must submit an application form and a formal sales contract with the EU customer. The association checks the contract’s signing date, delivery destination, planned shipment date and product specifications, ensuring the signing date precedes the application date, the destination is within the EU, the planned shipment is within three months of the application, and the product matches the requested category, confirming genuine export demand.

If the requested quantity far exceeds the applicant’s historical EU exports or other anomalies arise, the association will verify the contract’s authenticity and actual order status with the applicant before including it in that day’s allocation calculation. Allocation is performed daily: after the receipt deadline, if total requests exceed the remaining free quota, each qualified applicant receives a share proportional to its request relative to the total qualified requests, after which the results are entered into the Trade Administration’s online quota system for firms to view.

The quota management system includes access controls; once logged in, a firm can only view its own allocated quota and the overall total for that product category, not other firms’ applications, allocations, relinquishments or transfers, thereby protecting commercial confidentiality and personal data security.

During the period it handles quota management on behalf of the Trade Administration, the association will uphold confidentiality obligations, disclosing no individual contracts, allocated quotas or business data unless required by law or the competent authority, and stresses that it will continue to maintain fairness, impartiality and legal compliance to protect Taiwan’s steel export order and industry interests.

items.title: 主計總處：台灣8月失業率為3.41% 創26年來同期低
items.title_en: Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics: Taiwan's August unemployment rate 3.41%, lowest in 26 years
paras: 主計總處今(22)日公布我國8月失業率為3.41%，較上月上升0.02個百分點，但年減0.04個百分點，為26個年度以來同期最低，反映勞動市場穩定，累計前8月失業率平均為3.33%，年減0.02個百分點；主計總處也說明，非典型就業統計也將在10月開始公布，以反映非典型就業的增加。
主計總處指出，8月失業人數為41萬1000人，月增2000人或0.63%，主因應屆畢業生投入尋職行列，初次尋職失業者續增3000人；與去年同期相比，失業人數反而減少4000人或0.97%。
而前8月失業人數平均為40萬1000人，年減2000人或0.36%。
從就業面來看，8月就業人數為1165萬5000人，月增4000人或0.03%，其中服務業部門增加4000人或0.05%，農業部門增2000人或0.53%，工業部門則減2000人或0.07%；與去年同期相比，增加1萬4000人或0.12%。
前8月就業人數平均為1164萬3000人，年增2萬3000人或0.20%。
與主要國家相比，我國最新失業率為3.46%，加拿大7.3%，美國4.3%，德國4.2%，香港4.0%，日本2.4%，南韓2.0%，主計總處說明，日本與韓國失業率相對低主要是因非典型就業人口多，而台灣的非典就業統計將於10月發布。
paras_en: The Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics announced today (the 22nd) that Taiwan's unemployment rate for August was 3.41%, up 0.02 percentage points from the previous month but down 0.04 percentage points year‑on‑year, marking the lowest level for the same month in the past 26 years and indicating a stable labour market. The average unemployment rate for the first eight months was 3.33%, down 0.02 percentage points year‑on‑year, and the agency also said that statistics on atypical employment will begin to be released in October to reflect the rise in such jobs.

The agency noted that the number of unemployed persons in August was 411,000, an increase of 2,000 people or 0.63% from the previous month, mainly due to fresh graduates entering the job‑search pool, with first‑time job seekers rising by 3,000. Compared with the same period last year, the unemployed count actually fell by 4,000 people or 0.97%.
The average number of unemployed persons for the first eight months was 401,000, a year‑on‑year decrease of 2,000 people or 0.36%.

In terms of employment, August saw 11,655,000 employed persons, up 4,000 people or 0.03% from the previous month. The services sector added 4,000 jobs or 0.05%, agriculture added 2,000 jobs or 0.53%, while industry lost 2,000 jobs or 0.07%. Compared with the same month last year, employment increased by 14,000 people or 0.12%.
The average employment figure for the first eight months was 11,643,000, a year‑on‑year increase of 22,000 people or 0.20%.

Compared with major economies, Taiwan's latest unemployment rate stands at 3.46%, versus 7.3% in Canada, 4.3% in the United States, 4.2% in Germany, 4.0% in Hong Kong, 2.4% in Japan and 2.0% in South Korea. The agency explained that Japan’s and Korea’s lower rates are mainly due to a larger share of atypical employment, and Taiwan’s atypical employment statistics will be released in October.

items.title: 三商家購通過分割案 轉型為投控公司
items.title_en: SANSJIA Shopping Completes Split and Transforms into an Investment Holding Company
paras: 三商家購(2945-TW)今(22)日發布重訊指出，董事會決議通過公司分割案，將以分割方式將原經營的「美廉社」、「心樸市集」、「美廉便利架」、「Go美廉」等零售通路品牌相關資產、負債及營業，分割移轉予持股100%子公司富達零售，三商家購則轉型為投資控股公司，並更名為「眾聯投資控股股份有限公司」，負責集團資源整體規劃及智慧零售投資布局。
三商家購說明，此屬既有集團組織架構的重組與調整，對三商家購股東現有
股東權益並無影響，而集團管理效能與營運效率可望獲進一步提升，旗下各事業體將各自分工專注各自領域經營，未來將以策略投資或合資方式繼續納入策略合作夥伴，加速擴大零售經營規模。
本次分割基準日暫定為2027年1月1日，分割讓與的營業價值預計為新台幣2.5億元，換取富達零售新發行普通股2,500萬股，而有關零售通路分割案及轉型為投資控股公司相關議案，將11月18日召開的2026年度第一次股東臨時會中提請討論與決議。
轉型後，眾聯投控股票代號仍為2945，並將依相關規定向主管機關申請維持繼續上市資格。
未來富達零售將專注於零售通路品牌經營，實體通路除原來經營的便利商店OKmart和智能販賣機OKmini外，將新增「美廉社」、「心樸市集」、「美廉便利架」等三個實體通路品牌，線上通路則有「Go美廉」等。
三商家購進一步說明，未來購達行銷將聚焦於物流業務經營，首要目標為積極提升物流配送效率並逐步發展第三方物流服務；三友藥妝則負責藥妝通路拓展；寵物好事則持續深耕寵物食品及用品販售領域。
paras_en: SANSJIA Shopping (2945-TW) announced today (22nd) that its board of directors has approved a corporate split plan. The company will transfer the assets, liabilities, and operations of its retail channel brands—including Meilian Club, Xinpu Market, Meilian Convenience Shelf, and Go Meilian—to its wholly‑owned subsidiary Fuda Retail. SANSJIA Shopping will then transform into an investment holding company and rename itself "Zhonglian Investment Holding Co., Ltd.," responsible for overall group resource planning and smart‑retail investment strategy.
SANSJIA Shopping explained that this is a reorganization and adjustment of the existing group structure and will not affect the current equity of its shareholders.

The split is expected to further improve group management efficiency and operational effectiveness. Each business unit will focus on its own domain, and the group will continue to bring in strategic partners through strategic investments or joint ventures to accelerate the expansion of its retail scale.

The provisional split record date is set for January 1, 2027. The transferred business is valued at approximately NT$250 million, which will be exchanged for 25 million newly issued ordinary shares of Fuda Retail. The related split and transformation proposals will be presented for discussion and approval at the first extraordinary shareholders’ meeting for 2026, scheduled for November 18.
After the transformation, Zhonglian Investment Holding will retain the stock code 2945 and will apply to the regulator to maintain its listing status in accordance with applicable rules.

Going forward, Fuda Retail will focus on operating the retail channel brands. In addition to its existing convenience store OKmart and smart vending machine OKmini, it will add three physical retail brands—Meilian Club, Xinpu Market, and Meilian Convenience Shelf—while its online channel will include Go Meilian and others.

SANSJIA Shopping further explained that its marketing arm, Gouda Marketing, will concentrate on logistics operations, aiming first to improve delivery efficiency and gradually develop third‑party logistics services; Sanyou Cosmetics will handle the expansion of its drugstore and cosmetics channels; and Pet Good Things will continue to deepen its business in pet food and supplies.

items.title: 台股頻爆鉅額違約交割 金管會祭出「再犯者預收款券拉長至30天」
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Faces Surge in Large-Scale Default Deliveries; Financial Supervisory Commission Extends Pre‑payment Bond Hold Period to 30 Days for Repeat Offenders
paras: 台股今年波動加劇，屢傳鉅額違約交割案例，上市櫃已累積達 25 起，引發外界對市場風險與當沖控管的疑慮。對此，金管會證期局今(22)日表示，目前整體市場交割風險仍在可控範圍，但為了維持市場秩序並提醒投資人維護信用，金管會已正式核備證交所與櫃買中心提交的規章修正，祭出更嚴格的控管機制，未來投資人若發生違約，補足差額後，初犯將實施預收款券10天，再犯者處分期更將延長至30天。
證期局副局長黃仲豪指出，根據統計，2024年及2025年集中市場違約金額占全市場總成交金額的比率分別為10萬分之1.8與10萬分之1.1。今年前8個月因市場大幅波動，日均成交量放大至近1兆元，違約比率微幅上揚至10萬分之2.2。儘管整體市場結算交割秩序依然穩健，但主管機關仍決定出手加強風控。
黃仲豪說明，本次核備的違約管理新制主要著重於「違約處分」的強化，投資人初犯發生違約並補齊差額款項後，若欲再次進行交易，10天內皆需執行「預收款券」；若是再犯，原規定預收款券時間為10天，新制則將預收款券的管制時間大幅拉長至30天，以嚴格控管高風險投資人的交易行為。
外界關注新制何時上路？黃仲豪透露，雖然今日已完成規章核備，但具體上路時間仍需配合券商進行電腦系統調整與測試，今年底前上路恐有難度，將會儘快推動，待各單位準備就緒後即正式實施。
至於高槓桿交易與當沖風控，黃仲豪強調，現行機制已有嚴格規範，包括投資人適格性審查、每日評估當沖額度、每月檢視累積盈虧，以及針對當沖占比過高的股票列為注意股票提醒風險等。金管會呼籲投資人，進行股票交易時務必審慎評估自身風險承受度，妥善維護個人金融信用。
paras_en: Taiwan’s stock market has seen heightened volatility this year, with numerous large‑scale default delivery cases accumulating to 25 incidents across listed and OTC markets, raising concerns about market risk and day‑trading controls. In response, the Securities and Futures Bureau of the Financial Supervisory Commission said on the 22nd that overall settlement risk remains manageable, but to preserve market order and remind investors to uphold credit, the commission has formally approved rule amendments submitted by the Taiwan Stock Exchange and the OTC market, introducing stricter controls: first‑time violators who cover the shortfall will be subject to a 10‑day pre‑payment bond, while repeat offenders will face an extended period of up to 30 days.

Deputy Director Huang Zhong‑hao noted that statistics show default amounts in the central market accounted for 1.8 per 100,000 of total transaction value in 2024 and 1.1 per 100,000 in 2025. In the first eight months of this year, daily turnover surged to nearly NT$1 trillion amid sharp market swings, pushing the default rate slightly up to 2.2 per 100,000. Although overall settlement order remains sound, regulators have decided to tighten risk controls.

Huang explained that the newly approved default‑management regime focuses on strengthening “default penalties.” After a first‑time default and full repayment, investors must execute a pre‑payment bond for any trades within the next 10 days; for repeat offenses, the previous 10‑day bond requirement is extended to 30 days to strictly curb high‑risk trading behavior.

The public asks when the new rules will take effect. Huang said that while the rule amendments were approved today, implementation depends on broker‑deals’ system adjustments and testing, making a rollout before year‑end unlikely. Authorities will push forward as soon as all parties are ready, with formal enforcement to follow promptly.

Regarding high‑leverage trading and day‑trading risk controls, Huang emphasized that existing mechanisms already impose strict standards, including investor eligibility reviews, daily day‑trading limits, monthly profit‑and‑loss assessments, and alerts for stocks with excessive day‑trading ratios. The Financial Supervisory Commission urges investors to carefully assess their risk tolerance and maintain personal financial credit when trading stocks.

items.title: 台達電董座鄭平拜會印度總理莫迪 持續擴充在地產能聚焦三大領域
items.title_en: Delta Electronics Chairman Cheng Ping Meets Indian Prime Minister Modi, Continuing to Expand Local Capacity Focused on Three Key Areas
paras: 台達電(2308-TW)董事長暨執行長鄭平與台達電印度區總裁林正彬，近日赴印度拜會總理莫迪（Narendra Modi），共同討論台達電於印度在能源轉型、AI基礎設施及智慧製造領域的規劃與藍圖，並持續擴大在地製造產能。
鄭平強調，印度是台達電全球成長戰略的關鍵支柱，奠基於深耕當地超過二十年的基礎，包括位於班加羅爾的總部與研發中心，不僅奠定了台達電在印度的工程未來，也彰顯了對印度崛起的長期承諾，最終以同時支援本土成長與出口需求。
台達電也展示了其下一代清潔能源解決方案藍圖，包括氫能技術以及固體氧化物燃料電池（SOFC）與固體氧化物水電解槽（SOEC）解決方案，支持印度的能源轉型；這也是貫徹提供創新、清潔與高節能的解決方案，共創美好的明天的自然延伸。
台達電強調，將持續深化在印度的布局與實力，聚焦於AI資料中心、能源基礎設施及智慧製造，並將其定位為驅動印度數位與工業未來發展的核心引擎。莫迪也對這些戰略領域分享了看法，印度政府亦重申將全力支持台達電在印度的持續投資與擴建計畫。
paras_en: Delta Electronics (2308‑TW) Chairman and CEO Cheng Ping, together with the company’s India regional president Lin Zheng‑bin, recently traveled to India to meet Prime Minister Narendra Modi. They discussed Delta’s plans and roadmap in India for energy transition, AI infrastructure and smart manufacturing, and reaffirmed the company’s commitment to further expand local manufacturing capacity.

Cheng emphasized that India is a cornerstone of Delta’s global growth strategy, built on more than two decades of deep local presence, including a headquarters and R&D center in Bangalore. This foundation not only secures Delta’s engineering future in India but also demonstrates a long‑term commitment to the country’s rise, ultimately supporting both domestic growth and export demand.

Delta also showcased its next‑generation clean‑energy solution roadmap, featuring hydrogen technology as well as solid‑oxide fuel cell (SOFC) and solid‑oxide electrolysis (SOEC) solutions to back India’s energy transition. This aligns with Delta’s mission to deliver innovative, clean and highly efficient solutions for a better tomorrow.

Delta stressed that it will keep deepening its footprint and capabilities in India, concentrating on AI data centers, energy infrastructure and smart manufacturing, positioning itself as a core engine driving India’s digital and industrial future. Prime Minister Modi shared his views on these strategic areas, and the Indian government reiterated its full support for Delta’s ongoing investment and expansion plans in the country.

items.title: 機車族小確幸！上駕訓班考照投保強制險可領200元禮券 明年起試辦
items.title_en: A Small Joy for Scooter Riders! Enroll in a Training Course, Get a License, Insure Mandatory Coverage and Receive a NT$200 Voucher – Pilot Program Starts Next Year
paras: 為降低交通事故發生率，金管會保險局今(22)日宣布推出新政策，自2027年1月1日起試辦為期一年的「強制汽車責任保險機車駕訓獎勵措施」。未來民眾只要完成 250c.c. 以下機車駕訓班課程，於試辦期間考取駕照並投保強制車險，即可領取 200 元數位電子禮券，每人限領一次。
保險局長王麗惠說明，這是強制車險實施逾 28 年來，首次將損害防阻(事前預防)機制納入獎勵範疇，依現行規定，考機車駕照並未強制上駕訓班，但交通部統計顯示，曾接受駕訓者後續的違規與事故風險均大幅下降。為配合交通部推廣機車駕訓的補助政策，金管會特別加碼提供保費優惠獎勵，期能發揮跨部會「1+1>2」的減災效果。
王麗惠指出，以目前普通重型機車一年期保費658元、輕型機車保費424元計算，折抵200元獎勵金後，相當於保費直接打7折與53折。只要民眾參加的是250c.c.以下的機車駕訓(含普通重型與輕型機車)，即使是在明年1月1日前完訓，只要在明年試辦期間考取駕照並投保，皆符合領取資格。
全台 14 家有承作強制車險的產險業者將全部參與，至於經費預算，則是參考交通部2025年機車駕訓補助名額，以 5 萬人規模進行估算，總獎勵金約 1000 萬元，將由「汽車交通事故特別補償基金」來支付，不會增加業者與國庫額外負擔。
關於獎勵金領取流程，保險局官員指出，民眾於投保時提出申請後，產險公司將透過保發中心與公路監理系統進行跨部會資料勾稽，確認完訓與考照紀錄無誤後發給。目前採購作業進行中，初步規劃發放超商數位電子禮券。
對於政策效益評估，保險局已責成特補基金成立事後追蹤機制，除了事前宣導外，實施後將按季彙總執行情況，並深度分析參加機車駕訓者與未參加者在事故發生率及強制車險損失經驗上的關聯性。未來將視試辦成效，評估是否將該措施延長、常態化或進一步擴大辦理。
paras_en: To reduce traffic accidents, the Financial Supervisory Commission’s Insurance Bureau announced today (the 22nd) a new policy: starting January 1, 2027, a one‑year pilot “Mandatory Motor Vehicle Liability Insurance Scooter‑Training Reward Measure” will be trialed. Anyone who completes a scooter‑training course for motorcycles under 250 cc, obtains a license during the pilot period and purchases mandatory motor vehicle insurance will receive a NT$200 digital voucher, limited to one per person.

Insurance Bureau Director Wang Lihui explained that this is the first time in more than 28 years of mandatory motor vehicle insurance that a damage‑prevention (pre‑emptive) mechanism is incorporated into a reward scheme. Under current rules, taking a scooter‑training course is not required for a license, but Ministry of Transportation statistics show that trainees have significantly lower violation and accident risks. To align with the Ministry’s subsidy policy for scooter training, the FSC is adding premium‑discount rewards, hoping to achieve a cross‑agency “1+1>2” disaster‑reduction effect.

Wang noted that, based on the current annual premiums of NT$658 for standard heavy‑duty scooters and NT$424 for light‑duty scooters, a NT$200 reward translates to a 30% discount for heavy scooters and a 53% discount for light scooters. As long as participants take a training course for motorcycles under 250 cc (including both heavy‑ and light‑duty scooters), even if they finish the course before January 1 2027, they will be eligible for the voucher as long as they obtain a license and insure during the pilot period.

All 14 domestic property‑insurance companies that underwrite mandatory motor vehicle insurance will take part. The budget is based on the Ministry of Transportation’s 2025 scooter‑training subsidy quota, assuming 50,000 participants, resulting in a total reward pool of about NT$10 million, to be paid from the “Special Compensation Fund for Automobile Traffic Accidents.” This will not add any extra burden to insurers or the national treasury.

Regarding the reward‑claim process, insurance‑bureau officials said that after applicants submit a request at the time of purchase, the insurer will cross‑check training completion and licensing records through the insurance issuance center and the highway‑supervision system, then issue the voucher. Procurement is underway, with an initial plan to distribute digital vouchers redeemable at convenience stores.

For policy‑effect evaluation, the bureau has tasked the special compensation fund to set up a post‑implementation tracking mechanism. In addition to pre‑implementation outreach, quarterly reports will summarize implementation status and deeply analyze the relationship between training participation and accident rates as well as mandatory‑insurance loss experience. Depending on pilot results, authorities will consider extending, regularizing or expanding the measure.

items.title: Meta測試Muse真人禮賓功能！AI通話交給承包商引爆隱私疑慮
items.title_en: Meta Tests Muse Live Concierge Feature! Outsourcing AI Calls to Contractors Sparks Privacy Concerns
paras: Meta(META-US)正在測試一項名為「真人禮賓服務」的功能，讓人類承包商悄悄代替新推出的個人AI助理Muse撥打部分電話，引發部分員工對隱私與資訊揭露的疑慮。
《路透》看到的Meta內部貼文顯示，公司上周向員工公布這項測試，時間就在Muse正式推出電話功能後不久。部分員工警告，若由客服中心的人類人員處理通話，使用者可能在不知情的情況下，把敏感資訊透露給外部承包商。
Meta發言人Daniel Roberts表示，員工對這項功能的反應「極為正面」，測試目的在於蒐集意見，以便在對外推出前改善功能，並加入安全與隱私保護措施。Meta正與商家合作改善這項潛在功能，只有在準備完善並提供適當資訊揭露後才會正式上線。
Muse推出兩周以來已登上美國應用程式下載排行榜冠軍。市場情報公司Sensor Tower資料顯示，下載量已超過250萬次。Muse也是執行長祖克柏向Meta數十億使用者提供「個人超級智慧」計畫的核心產品，可自主代替使用者寄送電子郵件、購物及預訂旅程。
Meta推出Muse時大力宣傳安全設計，強調每個AI代理都擁有獨立的雲端「虛擬機器」，以隔離不同使用者的操作階段，密碼等敏感資料也會存放於另一個安全空間。
透過電話功能，使用者可要求Muse致電美國商家，代為預約剪髮、詢問庫存或向不同承包商取得報價。通話結束後，Muse會在應用程式內提供對話摘要及逐字稿。
Meta自8月起讓員工內部試用這項電話功能，並在Muse推出後逐步開放給使用者。上周約有一半Meta員工啟用真人禮賓測試，Muse可把電話需求轉交受過訓練的人員完成；不願參與的員工則可選擇退出。
paras_en: Meta (META-US) is testing a feature called “Live Concierge Service,” where human contractors quietly place some calls on behalf of the newly launched personal AI assistant Muse, raising privacy and information‑disclosure concerns among some employees.

Internal posts seen by Reuters show that the company announced the test to staff last week, shortly after Muse’s phone‑calling capability was officially rolled out. Some employees warned that if human staff at a call‑center handle the calls, users might unknowingly disclose sensitive information to external contractors.

Meta spokesperson Daniel Roberts said employee reaction to the feature has been “extremely positive,” and that the test is meant to gather feedback so the service can be refined and equipped with security and privacy safeguards before a public launch. Meta is working with merchants to improve the potential feature and will only roll it out once it is fully ready and proper disclosures are provided.

Since its launch two weeks ago, Muse has topped the U.S. app‑download charts. Data from market‑intelligence firm Sensor Tower show downloads have exceeded 2.5 million. Muse is also the core product of CEO Mark Zuckerberg’s “personal super‑intelligence” plan for Meta’s billions of users, capable of autonomously sending emails, shopping and booking travel on their behalf.

When Meta introduced Muse, it heavily promoted its safety design, emphasizing that each AI agent runs in an isolated cloud “virtual machine” to separate user sessions, with passwords and other sensitive data stored in a separate secure enclave.

Through the phone feature, users can ask Muse to call U.S. merchants to book a haircut, check inventory or obtain quotes from various contractors. After the call ends, Muse provides a conversation summary and transcript within the app.

Meta began internal testing of the phone feature with employees in August and has been gradually opening it to users since Muse’s launch. Last week about half of Meta’s staff opted into the live‑concierge test, allowing Muse to hand off call requests to trained human operators; employees who do not wish to participate can opt out.

items.title: Netflix真的沒好劇了？一周內二度遭降評 今年股價重挫23%
items.title_en: Netflix Really Has No Good Shows? Downgraded Twice in a Week, Stock Down 23% This Year
paras: Netflix(NFLX-US)周二(22日)不到一周內第二度遭華爾街調降評等，分析師擔心公司缺乏熱門原創作品，加上YouTube快速擴大客廳影音市場版圖，可能持續拖累用戶觀看參與度。Netflix盤中股價一度下跌1.7%，今年迄今累計重挫約23%，明顯落後同期上漲近14%的標普500指數。
匯豐銀行(HSBC)將Netflix投資評等由「買進」下調至「持有」，並把目標價由96美元大砍至76美元。分析師Mohammed Khallouf指出，Alphabet(GOOGL-US)旗下YouTube正在迅速擴大客廳螢幕市占率，Netflix因此受到衝擊，在美國整體電視觀看時間中的占比已降至多年低點。
Khallouf表示，Netflix近期原創內容的市場反應轉弱，讓YouTube從中受益，短期內觀看參與度不太可能復甦。
這也是Netflix不到一周內第二度遭到降評。富國證券上周五已調降Netflix評等，分析師Steven Cahall給予相當於「賣出」的評級。他指出，Netflix近期欠缺大型原創影集，這項弱點已反映在營運表現上；若股價想重新獲得上漲動能，公司必須推出能夠造成轟動的熱門作品。
Netflix股價近期疲弱，也與7月公布的財報及展望有關。公司當時預測，營收成長將連續第二季放緩。《彭博》彙整資料顯示，Netflix最近五次發布財報後，股價均出現負面反應。公司預定10月20日公布第三季財報，屆時新內容能否拉回觀眾並改善成長前景，將成為市場關注焦點。
paras_en: Netflix (NFLX-US) was downgraded for the second time in less than a week on Tuesday (the 22nd) by Wall Street analysts, who worry the company lacks hit original titles and that YouTube’s rapid expansion in the living‑room video market could continue to drag down user viewing engagement. Netflix’s intraday share price fell as much as 1.7%, and the stock is down about 23% year‑to‑date, lagging far behind the S&P 500’s roughly 14% gain over the same period.

HSBC lowered its investment rating on Netflix from “Buy” to “Hold” and cut the target price sharply from $96 to $76. Analyst Mohammed Khallouf noted that YouTube, owned by Alphabet (GOOGL-US), is quickly expanding its share of living‑room screens, hurting Netflix, whose share of total TV viewing time in the United States has fallen to a multi‑year low.
Khallouf said that the market response to Netflix’s recent original content has weakened, allowing YouTube to benefit, and that short‑term viewing engagement is unlikely to recover soon.

This marks the second downgrade for Netflix in less than a week. Wells Fargo Securities had already cut Netflix’s rating last Friday, with analyst Steven Cahall assigning a rating equivalent to “Sell.” He pointed out that Netflix’s recent lack of a major original series has shown up in its operating performance; for the stock to regain upward momentum, the company must launch a blockbuster hit that creates a buzz.

Netflix’s recent stock weakness is also tied to the earnings report and outlook released in July. The company then projected that revenue growth would slow for a second consecutive quarter. Bloomberg’s data shows that after each of Netflix’s last five earnings releases, the stock has reacted negatively. Netflix is scheduled to report its third‑quarter results on October 20, and whether new content can win back viewers and improve growth prospects will be a key focus for the market.

items.title: 一手升息、一手整頓美債！Fed官員釋出兩大重要訊號
items.title_en: One Hand Raises Rates, the Other Overhauls US Treasuries! Fed Officials Send Two Key Signals
paras: 波士頓聯準銀行總裁柯林斯(Susan Collins)與紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯(John Williams)周二(22日)分別就利率政策與美國公債市場改革釋出最新訊號。柯林斯表示，她支持聯準會(Fed)上周升息1碼，並預期今年底前可能再升息一次；威廉斯則指出，美債與附買回交易轉向集中清算的進度快於預期，Fed也將維持充裕且具彈性的銀行準備金供給，以確保金融市場順利運作。
Fed官員上周全員一致決議將基準利率調升1碼，為2023年以來首次升息。最新經濟預測顯示，政策官員對進一步升息的支持增加，其中16名官員預期今年至少還會升息一次，中位數預測也顯示年底前將再升息1碼。

柯林斯支持年底前再升息一次

柯林斯周二在LinkedIn發文表示，略微提高聯邦基金利率的限制程度，有助於確保通膨持續回到Fed的2%目標。隨著勞動市場狀況改善，貨幣政策可以更加聚焦於及時恢復物價穩定，尤其美國通膨已連續5年半高於目標。
今年並無貨幣政策投票權的柯林斯指出，通膨持續「明顯高於2%」的可能性正在升高。她周一接受《美聯社》訪問時透露，自己是預估年底前還會第二度升息的官員之一，並預期利率在2027年將維持不變。
Fed主席華許上周再次沒有提交利率預測。他表示，這次升息是從美國經濟中移除「一部分寬鬆」，顯示Fed希望在勞動市場保持穩健之際，進一步抑制通膨壓力。
威廉斯周二並未評論貨幣政策，而是將重點放在美國公債市場結構及銀行準備金供給。

美債集中清算進度超前

威廉斯表示，為迎接即將到來的期限，金融業已開始擴大美債現券與附買回交易的集中清算基礎設施，市場活動也比原定時程更早從非集中清算轉向集中清算。
相關改革要求符合資格的美國公債次級市場交易，以及附買回與反向附買回協議，必須透過集中交易對手進行清算，藉此降低交易對手風險，並強化全球最大公債市場的韌性。
威廉斯也重申，Fed目前維持「充裕」銀行準備金的運作架構，已有效確保市場利率維持在聯邦基金利率目標區間內，並支持金融市場正常運作。他強調，Fed承諾提供具彈性的準備金供給；如果監管、市場結構或其他因素導致準備金需求改變，Fed將隨時間調整供給加以配合。
2008年金融危機後，Fed採取充裕準備金架構，確保銀行體系擁有足夠現金，以滿足監管及交易結算需求。Fed去年底停止縮減資產負債表，並開始進行準備金管理購債，以把銀行準備金維持在期望的充裕水準。
paras_en: Boston Fed President Susan Collins and New York Fed President John Williams on Tuesday (the 22nd) each issued fresh signals on interest‑rate policy and reforms to the US Treasury market. Collins said she supports the Fed’s one‑basis‑point hike last week and expects another hike could come before year‑end; Williams noted that the shift of Treasury and repo trades to central clearing is progressing faster than expected, and the Fed will keep bank reserves ample and flexible to ensure smooth market functioning.

Fed officials last week unanimously voted to raise the policy rate by one basis point, marking the first hike since 2023. The latest economic forecasts show growing support among policymakers for further tightening, with 16 officials expecting at least one more hike this year and the median projection calling for another one‑basis‑point increase by year‑end.

Collins backs another rate hike before year‑end. In a LinkedIn post on Tuesday, she said a modest increase in the federal‑funds rate ceiling would help keep inflation on track to return to the Fed’s 2% target. With a strengthening labor market, monetary policy can focus more on restoring price stability, especially as US inflation has been above target for five and a half years.

Although she does not vote on policy this year, Collins warned that the odds of inflation staying “significantly above 2%” are rising. In an interview with the Associated Press on Monday, she said she is among the officials who expect a second hike before year‑end and projects rates to stay unchanged through 2027.

Fed Chair Jerome Powell again did not provide a rate forecast last week. He said the latest hike removes “a slice of accommodation” from the economy, showing the Fed’s intent to further curb inflation pressures while keeping the labor market robust.
Williams did not comment on monetary policy on Tuesday, focusing instead on the structure of the US Treasury market and the supply of bank reserves.

Williams said that, ahead of upcoming deadlines, the financial sector has begun expanding the central‑clearing infrastructure for Treasury cash and repo trades, and market activity has shifted to central clearing earlier than originally scheduled.

The reforms require that eligible secondary‑market Treasury trades, as well as repo and reverse‑repo agreements, be cleared through a central counterparty, reducing counterparty risk and bolstering the resilience of the world’s largest sovereign‑debt market.

Williams also reiterated that the Fed’s current “ample” reserve framework has effectively kept market rates within the federal‑funds target range and supported normal market operations. He emphasized the Fed’s commitment to flexible reserve provision and said the supply will be adjusted over time if regulatory, market‑structure or other factors change reserve demand.

After the 2008 financial crisis, the Fed adopted an ample‑reserves framework to ensure banks have enough cash to meet regulatory and settlement needs. The Fed stopped shrinking its balance sheet at the end of last year and began reserve‑management bond purchases to keep bank reserves at the desired ample level.

items.title: 當算力瓶頸變成電力瓶頸！大摩點名缺電這些「缺電概念股」迎暴增商機
items.title_en: When Computing Power Bottlenecks Turn Into Electricity Bottlenecks! Morgan Stanley Flags These “Power‑Shortage” Stocks for Explosive Opportunities
paras: 隨著運算能力與資料中心容量需求暴增，最新分析顯示，美國電網應對這波負載的能力可能比業界原先預期更不足，但也帶來潛在的投資機會。
摩根士丹利(Morgan Stanley)分析師Stephen Byrd周一(21日)預測，截至2028年，美國電力短缺將達33GW，相當於晶片需求的34%。不過這項估算未納入「供電所需時間」(time-to-power)解決方案，例如不依賴電網、可避開電網接入延遲的離網供電。

「有電的資料中心」成稀有資源

Byrd表示，儘管美國潛在電力缺口規模龐大，但也蘊藏可觀的投資機會。他認為能於這波電力供需失衡中受益的其中一類企業，是「有電外殼」(powered shell)供應商，也就是能重新利用既有電力與電網資源、將其改造成資料中心的企業。
Byrd推薦Cipher Digital(CIFR-US)、Hut 8(HUT-US)、Riot Platforms(RIOT-US)、Galaxy Digital(GLXY-US)及Terawulf(WULF-US)，並預期這些公司各自在未來六個月內至少簽署一筆大型資料中心租賃合約。
Freedom Capital Markets分析師Paul Meeks也表示，電力供需缺口「已經很大」，如果電力進一步短缺，情況可能「變得非常嚴峻」。這種情況可能推升Cipher Digital、Terawulf及Hut 8等公司的股價，因為這些企業已取得資料中心所需的電力協議。

「表後電力」需求升溫　發電設備商迎商機

Byrd表示，另一個值得關注的投資領域是發電設備。
他預期市場對「表後」或「用戶端」(behind-the-meter，BTM)發電將激增，使發電設備的需求出現「大幅成長」。這類供電方式讓資料中心等高耗能設施可以在現場儲存或取得電力，不必完全依賴公共電網。
Byrd推薦Bloom Energy(BE-US)、GE Vernova(GEV-US)及Cummins(CMI-US)。
他預期，未來幾個月將出現多筆「表後」發電交易，尤其是在德州西部。
此外，參與「表後」系統開發的企業，也可望與資料中心開發商及AI公司展開大量交易，例如Solaris Energy Infrastructure(SEI-US)及Vistra(VST-US)。

SpaceX另闢天然氣渦輪機戰場

SpaceX(SPCX-US)也可能因電力短缺受惠，但原因鮮為人知：該公司已進軍燃氣渦輪機領域。Byrd指出，SpaceX今年稍早收購電力供應商APR Energy，這是一家生產可移動式燃氣渦輪機及發電廠的公司。
Byrd說：「SpaceX一向會鎖定最限制規模擴張的因素並加以突破。隨著該公司在運算時間與供電成本方面建立護城河，它似乎已找到下一個目標：渦輪機葉片與導葉。」
paras_en: As computing power and data‑center capacity needs surge, the latest analysis shows the U.S. power grid may be less able to handle the load than the industry originally expected, but it also creates potential investment opportunities.

Morgan Stanley analyst Stephen Byrd forecast on Monday (the 21st) that by 2028 the United States will face a 33 GW electricity shortfall, roughly 34% of the chip demand. The estimate, however, does not factor in “time‑to‑power” solutions that avoid grid reliance and bypass grid‑connection delays, such as off‑grid power.

“Powered data centers” become a scarce resource. Byrd said that despite the massive potential power gap in the U.S., there are sizable investment opportunities. He believes one class of beneficiaries are “powered‑shell” providers – companies that can repurpose existing electricity and grid assets into data‑center facilities.

Byrd recommends Cipher Digital (CIFR‑US), Hut 8 (HUT‑US), Riot Platforms (RIOT‑US), Galaxy Digital (GLXY‑US) and Terawulf (WULF‑US), expecting each to sign at least one large data‑center lease within the next six months.

Freedom Capital Markets analyst Paul Meeks also noted the power supply‑demand gap is already huge, and further shortages could make the situation “very severe.” That could lift the stock prices of Cipher Digital, Terawulf, Hut 8 and similar firms that have already secured power agreements for data‑centers.
“Behind‑the‑meter” power demand heats up, creating opportunities for power‑equipment makers. Byrd highlighted another attractive investment area: power‑generation equipment.

He expects a surge in demand for “behind‑the‑meter” (BTM) generation, driving “significant growth” in equipment sales. This supply model lets high‑consumption facilities such as data centers store or obtain power on site without relying entirely on the public grid.
Byrd recommends Bloom Energy (BE‑US), GE Vernova (GEV‑US) and Cummins (CMI‑US).
He predicts multiple BTM generation deals will materialize in the coming months, especially in West Texas.
In addition, companies developing BTM systems could see large transactions with data‑center developers and AI firms, such as Solaris Energy Infrastructure (SEI‑US) and Vistra (VST‑US).

SpaceX opens a natural‑gas turbine battlefield. SpaceX (SPCX‑US) may also benefit from power shortages, though the reason is less known: the company has entered the gas‑turbine arena. Byrd noted SpaceX earlier this year acquired power‑supplier APR Energy, which builds mobile gas turbines and power plants.

Byrd said, “SpaceX always targets the factor that most limits scale‑up and breaks through it. As the company builds a moat around compute time and power‑costs, it appears to have found its next target: turbine blades and guide vanes.”

items.title: 美債市場少了一大買盤？避險基金基差交易降至逾兩年最低
items.title_en: Is the U.S. Treasury Market Losing a Major Buyer? Hedge Fund Basis Trades Drop to Two-Year Low
paras: 避險基金最青睞的美國公債交易之一正快速降溫。摩根士丹利(MS-US)估算，槓桿投資人的美債「基差交易」名目規模，已從今年初的1.26兆美元降至約9,000億美元，創逾兩年最低，反映公債期貨與現券之間的價差縮小，套利空間正在消失。
基差交易是避險基金利用大量借款，買進美國公債現券並賣出相對應期貨，押注兩者價差最終收斂。這項交易能增加公債需求，並替規模達32兆美元的美債市場提供流動性，因此規模縮小一度引發市場擔憂，害怕重要資金來源撤退。
不過，摩根士丹利與花旗(C-US)策略師認為，這項交易遠未消失，目前也沒有證據顯示美債市場承受壓力，規模下降主要是因為相對價值交易機會減少，而非避險基金被迫平倉。

短天期美債套利空間縮小

摩根士丹利Eli P. Carter率領的團隊指出，基差交易降溫主要集中在兩年期與五年期美債，原因是相關期貨與現券的價差收窄，使短天期合約的潛在報酬降低。相較之下，長天期美債基差交易仍受歡迎，與25年至30年期美債連結的期貨部位甚至有所增加。
美國商品期貨交易委員會(CFTC)資料顯示，資產管理公司今年降低對短天期美債期貨的淨多頭部位。美伊戰爭爆發前，市場原本預期Fed將降息，但油價大漲後，預期轉向升息。隨著資產管理公司對期貨的需求轉弱，期貨相對現券的溢價也隨之縮小，壓縮避險基金的套利空間。
花旗美國利率策略主管Jason Williams表示，過去幾年市場價差與波動顯著下降，導致基差交易部位縮減。這未必代表風險升高，反而可能顯示市場對美國公債的實際需求比外界想像更強。
美國財政部買回流動性較差的舊券、Fed停止量化緊縮，加上銀行持有公債的意願提高，也降低期貨與現券出現價格錯位的機會，使基差交易吸引力進一步下降。

規模縮水不等於市場拉警報

美債市場規模持續擴大後，愈來愈依賴避險基金提供流動性，監管機關多年來也持續警告，槓桿部位若突然撤退，可能引發市場動盪。2020年3月市場陷入恐慌時，避險基金大舉平倉基差交易，最終必須由Fed買進債券並提供附買回融資，才能穩定市場。
摩根士丹利策略師指出，若美債市場劇烈震盪，或短期融資市場承受壓力，仍可能觸發基差交易平倉。不過，這項策略近期經歷多次市場動盪仍維持穩定，加上附買回市場資金充裕，因此目前的韌性令人安心。
芝商所(CME-US)全球利率與場外交易產品主管Agha Mirza表示，基差交易已充分發揮作用，並具備自然修正機制；交易規模因經濟誘因減弱而縮小，不會影響整體美債殖利率水準。
paras_en: One of the U.S. Treasury trades most favored by hedge funds is cooling rapidly. Morgan Stanley (MS-US) estimates that the notional size of leveraged investors' Treasury "basis trades" has fallen from $1.26 trillion at the start of the year to about $900 billion, a two‑year low, reflecting a narrowing spread between Treasury futures and cash bonds and the disappearance of arbitrage opportunities.

Basis trades involve hedge funds borrowing heavily to buy Treasury cash bonds while selling the corresponding futures, betting that the price gap will converge. The trades boost bond demand and provide liquidity to the $32 trillion Treasury market, so the shrinkage has sparked concerns that a key source of funding might retreat.

However, Morgan Stanley and Citi (C-US) strategists say the trade is far from gone and there is no evidence the Treasury market is under pressure; the decline is mainly due to fewer relative‑value opportunities rather than forced unwindings by hedge funds.

Short‑term Treasury arbitrage has narrowed. Morgan Stanley’s team led by Eli P. Carter notes the cooling is concentrated in the two‑year and five‑year segments, where futures‑cash spreads have tightened and potential returns on short‑dated contracts have fallen. By contrast, long‑dated basis trades remain popular, with positions linked to 25‑ to 30‑year bonds even expanding.

CFTC data show asset managers have reduced net long positions in short‑dated Treasury futures this year. Before the war in Ukraine, markets expected the Fed to cut rates, but after oil surged expectations shifted to hikes. Weaker demand for futures has compressed the futures‑cash premium, squeezing hedge‑fund arbitrage space.

Citi’s U.S. rates strategist Jason Williams says the market’s spread and volatility have dropped markedly over the past few years, shrinking basis‑trade positions. This does not necessarily signal higher risk; it may indicate that actual demand for Treasuries is stronger than perceived.

The Treasury’s buy‑back of less‑liquid older issues, the Fed’s halt to quantitative tightening, and banks’ greater willingness to hold Treasuries all reduce the chance of price dislocations between futures and cash, further lowering the appeal of basis trades.

A shrinking size does not equal a market alarm. As the Treasury market has grown, it has become increasingly reliant on hedge‑fund liquidity, and regulators have warned that a sudden pull‑back of leveraged positions could cause turbulence. In March 2020, during a panic, hedge funds massively unwound basis trades, forcing the Fed to buy bonds and provide repo financing to stabilize the market.

Morgan Stanley strategists caution that a severe shock to the Treasury market or stress in short‑term funding could still trigger basis‑trade unwindings. Yet the strategy has weathered recent volatility, and ample repo funding supports its resilience, which is reassuring.

Agha Mirza, head of global rates and OTC products at CME, says basis trades have fully performed their role and possess a natural corrective mechanism; the reduction in trade size reflects weaker economic incentives and will not affect overall Treasury yield levels.

items.title: 不想再為Token付費？蘋果推新Mac正面挑戰微軟、輝達
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US)新款Mac桌機周二(22日)開賣，公司將向企業客戶提出一項不同以往的訴求：與租用資料中心相比，直接購買能在本地執行人工智慧(AI)工作的Mac可能更便宜，也不必持續向OpenAI或Anthropic等雲端服務商支付以「Token」計價的運算費用。
升級版Mac mini與Mac Studio最高售價接近2萬美元，可直接處理程式編寫及複雜企業工作等高負載AI任務。新機將迎戰輝達(NVDA-US)及多家個人電腦製造商推出的AI桌機，相關產品預料也將成為微軟(MSFT-US)下月在舊金山舉行Windows活動的焦點。
蘋果希望憑藉長年在iPhone等電池供電裝置上提高效能、降低耗電的經驗，搶進微軟長期占據優勢的企業電腦市場。不過，挑戰仍相當艱鉅。IDC分析師Linn Huang表示，蘋果目前在企業桌機市場的占有率僅4.6%，遠低於Windows的91.3%。

統一記憶體意外成為AI利器

蘋果共同創辦人賈伯斯過去對企業運算興趣有限，因為終端使用者通常無法自行選擇偏好的產品。但蘋果長期追求省電效率，反而使Mac在裝置端AI興起後占據有利位置。
蘋果2020年推出首款Apple Silicon晶片時，把傳統個人電腦中彼此分離的運算與記憶體元件整合為統一記憶體架構，原本是為提升電池續航力，卻也讓處理器能更有效率地存取大量資料，使Mac特別適合執行AI模型。輝達等業者近年也開始朝類似架構發展。
開源代理型AI工具OpenClaw在中國等市場走紅後，Mac mini一度熱銷缺貨。Mac Studio最初鎖定影音與音樂創作者，但蘋果過去兩年陸續加入多項特殊AI功能，包括「Thunderbolt上的遠端直接記憶體存取」(RDMA over Thunderbolt)，讓多台電腦能更快速地共享資料及協同運算。
蘋果本月在發表會上展示4台串聯的Mac Studio，執行規模達1兆個參數的AI模型，並找出及修復繪圖程式錯誤。這類任務過去通常必須交由資料中心完成。

買斷硬體挑戰雲端計價模式

蘋果硬體技術資深副總裁Johny Srouji表示，企業把機器放上辦公桌並完成付款後，便能重複使用，不必支付每次AI運算產生的Token費用，因此Mac不只具備效能優勢，也能提供具競爭力的成本。
微軟也在爭取相同市場。執行長納德拉把裝置端AI稱為「不受計量的智慧」，並計劃將多項AI功能整合進Windows「超級應用程式」。不過，Windows必須支援眾多供應商的硬體，可能增加開發者針對不同晶片最佳化AI程式的難度。
微軟表示，公司正與晶片合作夥伴透過Windows ML工具簡化AI工作流程，RDMA等功能也是目前積極投資的領域。輝達則未發表評論，但黃仁勳先前淡化與蘋果直接競爭的說法，強調輝達的目標是擴大Windows電腦的能力，其主要優勢仍在資料中心。
Johny Srouji表示，蘋果不同裝置的晶片採用共同原則與設計，因此企業在Mac上開發的裝置端AI模型，既能擴大至最高階Mac Studio，也可縮小至價格最低的iPhone及iPad，讓客戶依照效能、成本與使用情境選擇合適產品。

items.title: 特斯拉新款Roadster重新開放預訂 訂金高達5萬美元
items.title_en: Tesla Reopens Reservations for New Roadster with $50,000 Deposit
paras: 美國電動車大廠特斯拉(TSLA-US) 將在10月1日發表新款跑車Roadster，目前官網已重新開放預訂，要求潛在買家支付5,000美元訂金，然後在支付訂金後10天內通過銀行轉賬支付45,000美元尾款，訂金可退還。
第一代Roadster於2008年發表，一直銷售到2012年。第二代Roadster最早於2017年提出概念，並在當時向意向客戶收取5萬美元訂金，最初特斯拉計劃在2020年開始交付，但隨後因特斯拉優先生產其他產品而跳票。
特斯拉迄今仍未公布新款Roadster售價，但業界估計超過25萬美元。
特斯拉在2017年發表的新一代Roadster跑車，起售價為20萬美元，百公里加速時間為1.9秒，續航里程為620英里。
此外，特斯拉還推出限量版創始系列，預售價格為25萬美元。
目前尚不清楚重新設計的Roadster做了哪些具體改動。與此同時，特斯拉如何處理在2017年就預訂Roadster的客戶也不得而知，特斯拉並未透露Roadster是否開放優先預訂權，以及預訂數量是否有限制。
特斯拉在官網表示，仍在確定車輛的配置、功能和硬體，因此暫時無法提供確切價格。客戶的最終購買價格將在選定配置後確定。
即便如此，遠高於特斯拉其他車型的預訂金額也顯示出Roadster身價不菲。特斯拉在2016年推出的Model 3車型，預訂金額為1,000美元；特斯拉在2019年發表的Cybertruck訂金只需要100美元。
paras_en: Tesla (TSLA-US) will unveil its new Roadster sports car on October 1, and the company’s website has reopened reservations, requiring potential buyers to pay a $5,000 deposit and then, within ten days of paying the deposit, wire the remaining $45,000 balance. The deposit is refundable.

The first‑generation Roadster was launched in 2008 and sold through 2012. The second‑generation Roadster was first teased in 2017, at which time Tesla collected $50,000 deposits from interested customers. Tesla originally planned to begin deliveries in 2020, but later postponed the launch to prioritize other products.
Tesla has not yet disclosed the price of the new Roadster, but industry estimates put it above $250,000.
When Tesla unveiled the next‑generation Roadster in 2017, it was priced from $200,000, boasted a 0‑to‑100 km/h (0‑62 mph) acceleration time of 1.9 seconds, and a range of 620 miles.
In addition, Tesla introduced a limited‑edition Founder’s Series with a pre‑sale price of $250,000.

It is still unclear what specific changes the redesigned Roadster incorporates. At the same time, how Tesla will handle customers who placed orders back in 2017 remains unknown; the company has not said whether existing customers will receive priority reservation rights or if there is a cap on the number of new reservations.

Tesla’s website states that vehicle configurations, features and hardware are still being finalized, so a definitive price cannot be provided at this time. The final purchase price will be determined after the buyer selects the desired configuration.

Even so, the far higher reservation amount compared with Tesla’s other models underscores the Roadster’s premium value. Tesla’s Model 3, launched in 2016, required a $1,000 reservation deposit, while the Cybertruck announced in 2019 required only a $100 deposit.

items.title: 獲利暴增卻愈來愈便宜！輝達本益比跌破17倍 市場到底在怕什麼？
items.title_en: Profit Soars Yet Stock Gets Cheaper! Nvidia's P/E Falls Below 17‑Times – What Is the Market Afraid Of?
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)營收與獲利持續高速成長，股價今年也上漲22%，但估值卻降至逾十年來接近最低水準。這項反常變化正在向市場發出警訊：投資人懷疑輝達目前的獲利能力能否長期維持，尤其在記憶體成本上升、客戶自行研發晶片及AI支出前景面臨質疑之際。
《彭博》彙整資料顯示，輝達目前股價不到未來12個月預估獲利的17倍，僅約2025年本益比的一半，也遠低於今年5月超過25倍的水準。TCW資深投資組合經理Eli Horton表示，估值明顯下修，代表市場對輝達目前獲利動能的持續性抱持高度懷疑；即使基本面極為強勁，股價表現仍顯示市場預期低於分析師共識。

基本面狂飆 股價卻落後晶片同業

輝達周一完成連續第五個交易日上漲。Meta(META-US)新AI代理程式初步表現亮眼，提振市場對晶片需求的信心，費城半導體指數當天大漲4.3%，創8月4日以來最佳表現。此前AI業界領袖呼籲放慢先進模型開發，一度引發市場恐慌，導致該指數9月14日重挫近6%。
儘管資料中心建設面臨反對聲浪，利率也持續攀升，目前仍沒有跡象顯示AI基礎設施投資即將降溫。市場預估，輝達2027會計年度營收與淨利將分別大增90%及99%，高於前一年度兩者均成長65%的表現。輝達上月也預測，2028會計年度營收將成長70%，遠高於市場原先預估的45%。
輝達今年上漲22%，在「美股七雄」中僅次於蘋果(AAPL-US)的25%，但明顯落後其他半導體業者。費城半導體指數今年已大漲近76%，美光(MU-US)、英特爾(INTC-US)及超微(AMD-US)漲幅更均超過180%；輝達反而是指數中表現第五差的成分股。
黃仁勳本月稍早表示，輝達是「全球第一家、也是唯一一家成長型價值股」，並稱公司遭到市場嚴重誤解，因為輝達不僅持續成長，也在同時擴大市場占有率。

毛利率承壓 客戶自研晶片成隱憂

估值無法提升的一大原因是獲利率面臨壓力，尤其記憶體晶片等關鍵零組件成本持續上升。輝達第二季毛利率高達75%，但分析師平均預估，第四季可能降至72%以下，之後才會逐季回升。
TradeStation全球市場策略主管David Russell指出，毛利率是壓抑輝達股價的重要因素。隨著主要客戶自行開發AI晶片，市場競爭可能進一步升高。Meta近期積極宣傳自研晶片，Alphabet(GOOGL-US)也已把自家晶片發展成重要業務。
Russell認為，大型科技公司希望降低對輝達的依賴，因此輝達的市場地位可能隨時間轉弱，毛利率走低的可能性也高於改善。企業只有在競爭地位穩固、前景可能持續變好時，估值才容易擴張，但市場目前不認為輝達具備這項條件。
不過，Horton認為，輝達目前估值似乎已反映AI資本支出放緩的情境，而這必須建立在大型雲端服務商削減投資，或監管措施延後甚至阻止AI發展的前提上；目前兩種情況看來都不太可能發生。因此，他認為輝達的低本益比反而提供頗具吸引力的進場點，未來估值向上修復的機率高於進一步下滑。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) continues to post rapid revenue and profit growth, and its stock is up 22% this year, but its valuation has slipped to the lowest level in over a decade. This odd shift is sounding a warning bell: investors doubt whether Nvidia can sustain its profit power over the long term, especially as memory costs rise, customers develop their own chips, and the outlook for AI spending faces scrutiny.

Bloomberg’s compiled data shows Nvidia’s current price is less than 17 times estimated earnings for the next 12 months – roughly half of its 2025 forward P/E and far below the more than 25‑times level seen in May. TCW senior portfolio manager Eli Horton says the valuation cut clearly signals the market’s strong skepticism about the durability of Nvidia’s profit momentum; even with a very strong fundamentals backdrop, the stock’s performance reflects expectations that fall short of analyst consensus.

Fundamentals are soaring but the stock lags peers. Nvidia logged its fifth straight day of gains on Monday. Meta’s (META-US) new AI agent posted impressive early results, boosting confidence in chip demand, and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index jumped 4.3% that day – its best performance since August 4. Earlier, AI‑industry leaders had urged a slowdown in advanced model development, sparking market panic that sent the index down nearly 6% on September 14.

Despite opposition to data‑center construction and rising interest rates, there are no signs that AI‑infrastructure investment is cooling. The market projects Nvidia’s FY2027 revenue and net income to surge 90% and 99% respectively, outpacing the prior year’s 65% growth on both fronts. Nvidia also forecast last month that FY2028 revenue will grow 70%, far above the market’s original 45% estimate.

Nvidia’s 22% rise this year makes it the second‑best performer among the “Big Seven” U.S. stocks, trailing only Apple (AAPL-US) at 25%, but it clearly lags other chip makers. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index is up nearly 76% year‑to‑date, while Micron (MU-US), Intel (INTC-US) and AMD (AMD-US) have each climbed over 180%; Nvidia is actually the fifth‑worst performer among the index’s components.

Jensen Huang said earlier this month that Nvidia is “the world’s first and only growth‑value stock,” adding that the company is severely misunderstood by the market because it not only continues to grow but also expands its market share.

Margin pressure and customer‑in‑house chip development are hidden risks. A key reason the valuation can’t rise is profit margin strain, especially as costs for critical components like memory chips keep climbing. Nvidia’s Q2 gross margin hit 75%, but analysts on average expect it could dip below 72% in Q4 before gradually recovering in subsequent quarters.

TradeStation’s global market strategy head David Russell notes that margin pressure is a major factor suppressing Nvidia’s stock. As major customers start building their own AI chips, competition could intensify further. Meta has recently pushed its own chip development, and Alphabet (GOOGL-US) has also turned its chip program into a core business.

Russell believes large tech firms want to reduce reliance on Nvidia, so Nvidia’s market position may weaken over time and margin erosion is more likely than improvement. Valuation can expand only when a company’s competitive footing is solid and prospects are likely to keep improving, but the market currently doesn’t see Nvidia meeting those conditions.

However, Horton argues that Nvidia’s current valuation already reflects a scenario of slowed AI cap‑ex, which would require large cloud providers to cut spending or regulators to delay or block AI development – both of which seem unlikely. Therefore, he sees Nvidia’s low P/E as an attractive entry point, with a higher probability of valuation upside than further downside.

items.title: Meta測試Muse真人禮賓功能！AI通話交給承包商引爆隱私疑慮
items.title_en: Meta Tests Muse Live Concierge Feature! Outsourcing AI Calls to Contractors Sparks Privacy Concerns
paras: Meta(META-US)正在測試一項名為「真人禮賓服務」的功能，讓人類承包商悄悄代替新推出的個人AI助理Muse撥打部分電話，引發部分員工對隱私與資訊揭露的疑慮。
《路透》看到的Meta內部貼文顯示，公司上周向員工公布這項測試，時間就在Muse正式推出電話功能後不久。部分員工警告，若由客服中心的人類人員處理通話，使用者可能在不知情的情況下，把敏感資訊透露給外部承包商。
Meta發言人Daniel Roberts表示，員工對這項功能的反應「極為正面」，測試目的在於蒐集意見，以便在對外推出前改善功能，並加入安全與隱私保護措施。Meta正與商家合作改善這項潛在功能，只有在準備完善並提供適當資訊揭露後才會正式上線。
Muse推出兩周以來已登上美國應用程式下載排行榜冠軍。市場情報公司Sensor Tower資料顯示，下載量已超過250萬次。Muse也是執行長祖克柏向Meta數十億使用者提供「個人超級智慧」計畫的核心產品，可自主代替使用者寄送電子郵件、購物及預訂旅程。
Meta推出Muse時大力宣傳安全設計，強調每個AI代理都擁有獨立的雲端「虛擬機器」，以隔離不同使用者的操作階段，密碼等敏感資料也會存放於另一個安全空間。
透過電話功能，使用者可要求Muse致電美國商家，代為預約剪髮、詢問庫存或向不同承包商取得報價。通話結束後，Muse會在應用程式內提供對話摘要及逐字稿。
Meta自8月起讓員工內部試用這項電話功能，並在Muse推出後逐步開放給使用者。上周約有一半Meta員工啟用真人禮賓測試，Muse可把電話需求轉交受過訓練的人員完成；不願參與的員工則可選擇退出。
paras_en: Meta (META-US) is testing a feature called “Live Concierge Service,” where human contractors quietly place some calls on behalf of the newly launched personal AI assistant Muse, raising privacy and information‑disclosure concerns among some employees.

Internal posts seen by Reuters show that the company announced the test to staff last week, shortly after Muse’s phone‑calling capability was officially rolled out. Some employees warned that if human staff at a call‑center handle the calls, users might unknowingly disclose sensitive information to external contractors.

Meta spokesperson Daniel Roberts said employee reaction to the feature has been “extremely positive,” and that the test is meant to gather feedback so the service can be refined and equipped with security and privacy safeguards before a public launch. Meta is working with merchants to improve the potential feature and will only roll it out once it is fully ready and proper disclosures are provided.

Since its launch two weeks ago, Muse has topped the U.S. app‑download charts. Data from market‑intelligence firm Sensor Tower show downloads have exceeded 2.5 million. Muse is also the core product of CEO Mark Zuckerberg’s “personal super‑intelligence” plan for Meta’s billions of users, capable of autonomously sending emails, shopping and booking travel on their behalf.

When Meta introduced Muse, it heavily promoted its safety design, emphasizing that each AI agent runs in an isolated cloud “virtual machine” to separate user sessions, with passwords and other sensitive data stored in a separate secure enclave.

Through the phone feature, users can ask Muse to call U.S. merchants to book a haircut, check inventory or obtain quotes from various contractors. After the call ends, Muse provides a conversation summary and transcript within the app.

Meta began internal testing of the phone feature with employees in August and has been gradually opening it to users since Muse’s launch. Last week about half of Meta’s staff opted into the live‑concierge test, allowing Muse to hand off call requests to trained human operators; employees who do not wish to participate can opt out.

items.title: 美銀示警：若供應進一步收緊 油價恐突破每桶150美元
items.title_en: Bank of America Warns: If Supply Tightens Further, Oil Prices Could Surge Past $150 per Barrel
paras: 美國銀行(BAC-US) 指出，若伊朗戰事持續、原油庫存不斷下降，油價可能升破每桶150美元。該行並將布蘭特原油年底目標價，從每桶83美元上調至95美元。
美銀全球商品、股票衍生性金融商品及跨資產量化投資策略主管布蘭奇（Francisco Blanch）率領的策略師團隊，在周二(23日)發布的報告中表示：「儘管替代運輸路線及護航船隊通過荷姆茲海峽，已緩解部分供應缺口，但基礎設施受損，加上地緣政治緊張升高，供應不太可能迅速恢復正常。」
目前，約占全球原油貿易三分之一的荷姆茲海峽，船舶通行受到嚴重限制；與伊朗關係密切的葉門胡塞武裝也鎖定沙烏地阿拉伯能源基礎設施發動攻擊，導致部分設施一度暫停運作。
不過，路透社週二稍早報導指出，沙烏地阿拉伯國家石油公司（Saudi Aramco）正重啟東西向輸油管線的作業，最快可在當天稍晚重啟紅海港口延布的原油出口。
消息傳出後，國際基準布蘭特原油與美國基準西德州原油價格，周二稍早分別跌破每桶100美元與90美元。
美銀策略師預估，2027年布蘭特原油平均價格約為每桶80美元，但也指出，隨著戰略儲備下降，且市場顯示短期供應嚴重短缺，油市仍面臨挑戰。
該團隊在報告中指出，儘管市場供應吃緊，但若經所得與通膨調整後，能源價格相對而言仍在可負擔範圍內，且經濟成長尚未放緩。因此，若供應中斷的情況持續至2027年春季，或油氣基礎設施的受損程度加劇，ICE布蘭特原油近月合約價格恐須大幅飆升至每桶150美元以上，才能有效抑制全球原油需求。
美銀估計，美國與以色列開始空襲伊朗時，荷姆茲海峽受阻的原油供應量約為每日1,400萬桶，近期則平均降至每日400萬至800萬桶。
paras_en: Bank of America (BAC-US) noted that if the conflict in Iran continues and crude inventories keep falling, oil prices could break above $150 a barrel. The bank also raised its year‑end Brent crude target from $83 to $95 per barrel.

Francisco Blanch, head of global commodities, equity derivatives and cross‑asset quantitative investment strategies at BofA, led a team of strategists that said in a report released on Tuesday (the 23rd): “Although alternative shipping routes and escort fleets through the Hormuz Strait have eased part of the supply gap, damaged infrastructure and heightened geopolitical tension mean supply is unlikely to return to normal quickly.”

Currently, the Hormuz Strait – which handles about one‑third of global crude trade – is seeing severe vessel‑traffic restrictions; Yemen’s Houthi forces, closely aligned with Iran, have also targeted Saudi energy infrastructure, causing some facilities to shut down temporarily.

However, Reuters reported earlier on Tuesday that Saudi Aramco is restarting operations on its east‑west oil pipeline, which could allow the Red Sea port of Yanbu to resume crude exports later that day.
After the news broke, benchmark Brent crude and the U.S. West Texas Intermediate both fell below $100 and $90 a barrel respectively in early trade on Tuesday.

BofA strategists project the average Brent price in 2027 to be about $80 a barrel, but they also note that strategic reserves are declining and the market is showing a severe short‑term supply shortage, keeping the oil market under pressure.

The team said that even though supply is tight, after adjusting for income and inflation, energy prices remain relatively affordable and economic growth has not yet slowed. Therefore, if supply disruptions persist into the spring of 2027 or damage to oil‑gas infrastructure worsens, near‑month ICE Brent contracts could have to surge well above $150 a barrel to effectively curb global crude demand.

BofA estimates that when the United States and Israel began air strikes on Iran, the Hormuz Strait blockage cut crude supply to about 14 million barrels per day, and that figure has recently averaged between 4 million and 8 million barrels per day.

items.title: Netflix真的沒好劇了？一周內二度遭降評 今年股價重挫23%
items.title_en: Netflix Really Has No Good Shows? Downgraded Twice in a Week, Stock Down 23% This Year
paras: Netflix(NFLX-US)周二(22日)不到一周內第二度遭華爾街調降評等，分析師擔心公司缺乏熱門原創作品，加上YouTube快速擴大客廳影音市場版圖，可能持續拖累用戶觀看參與度。Netflix盤中股價一度下跌1.7%，今年迄今累計重挫約23%，明顯落後同期上漲近14%的標普500指數。
匯豐銀行(HSBC)將Netflix投資評等由「買進」下調至「持有」，並把目標價由96美元大砍至76美元。分析師Mohammed Khallouf指出，Alphabet(GOOGL-US)旗下YouTube正在迅速擴大客廳螢幕市占率，Netflix因此受到衝擊，在美國整體電視觀看時間中的占比已降至多年低點。
Khallouf表示，Netflix近期原創內容的市場反應轉弱，讓YouTube從中受益，短期內觀看參與度不太可能復甦。
這也是Netflix不到一周內第二度遭到降評。富國證券上周五已調降Netflix評等，分析師Steven Cahall給予相當於「賣出」的評級。他指出，Netflix近期欠缺大型原創影集，這項弱點已反映在營運表現上；若股價想重新獲得上漲動能，公司必須推出能夠造成轟動的熱門作品。
Netflix股價近期疲弱，也與7月公布的財報及展望有關。公司當時預測，營收成長將連續第二季放緩。《彭博》彙整資料顯示，Netflix最近五次發布財報後，股價均出現負面反應。公司預定10月20日公布第三季財報，屆時新內容能否拉回觀眾並改善成長前景，將成為市場關注焦點。
paras_en: Netflix (NFLX-US) was downgraded for the second time in less than a week on Tuesday (the 22nd) by Wall Street analysts, who worry the company lacks hit original titles and that YouTube’s rapid expansion in the living‑room video market could continue to drag down user viewing engagement. Netflix’s intraday share price fell as much as 1.7%, and the stock is down about 23% year‑to‑date, lagging far behind the S&P 500’s roughly 14% gain over the same period.

HSBC lowered its investment rating on Netflix from “Buy” to “Hold” and cut the target price sharply from $96 to $76. Analyst Mohammed Khallouf noted that YouTube, owned by Alphabet (GOOGL-US), is quickly expanding its share of living‑room screens, hurting Netflix, whose share of total TV viewing time in the United States has fallen to a multi‑year low.
Khallouf said that the market response to Netflix’s recent original content has weakened, allowing YouTube to benefit, and that short‑term viewing engagement is unlikely to recover soon.

This marks the second downgrade for Netflix in less than a week. Wells Fargo Securities had already cut Netflix’s rating last Friday, with analyst Steven Cahall assigning a rating equivalent to “Sell.” He pointed out that Netflix’s recent lack of a major original series has shown up in its operating performance; for the stock to regain upward momentum, the company must launch a blockbuster hit that creates a buzz.

Netflix’s recent stock weakness is also tied to the earnings report and outlook released in July. The company then projected that revenue growth would slow for a second consecutive quarter. Bloomberg’s data shows that after each of Netflix’s last five earnings releases, the stock has reacted negatively. Netflix is scheduled to report its third‑quarter results on October 20, and whether new content can win back viewers and improve growth prospects will be a key focus for the market.

items.title: 一手升息、一手整頓美債！Fed官員釋出兩大重要訊號
items.title_en: One Hand Raises Rates, the Other Overhauls US Treasuries! Fed Officials Send Two Key Signals
paras: 波士頓聯準銀行總裁柯林斯(Susan Collins)與紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯(John Williams)周二(22日)分別就利率政策與美國公債市場改革釋出最新訊號。柯林斯表示，她支持聯準會(Fed)上周升息1碼，並預期今年底前可能再升息一次；威廉斯則指出，美債與附買回交易轉向集中清算的進度快於預期，Fed也將維持充裕且具彈性的銀行準備金供給，以確保金融市場順利運作。
Fed官員上周全員一致決議將基準利率調升1碼，為2023年以來首次升息。最新經濟預測顯示，政策官員對進一步升息的支持增加，其中16名官員預期今年至少還會升息一次，中位數預測也顯示年底前將再升息1碼。

柯林斯支持年底前再升息一次

柯林斯周二在LinkedIn發文表示，略微提高聯邦基金利率的限制程度，有助於確保通膨持續回到Fed的2%目標。隨著勞動市場狀況改善，貨幣政策可以更加聚焦於及時恢復物價穩定，尤其美國通膨已連續5年半高於目標。
今年並無貨幣政策投票權的柯林斯指出，通膨持續「明顯高於2%」的可能性正在升高。她周一接受《美聯社》訪問時透露，自己是預估年底前還會第二度升息的官員之一，並預期利率在2027年將維持不變。
Fed主席華許上周再次沒有提交利率預測。他表示，這次升息是從美國經濟中移除「一部分寬鬆」，顯示Fed希望在勞動市場保持穩健之際，進一步抑制通膨壓力。
威廉斯周二並未評論貨幣政策，而是將重點放在美國公債市場結構及銀行準備金供給。

美債集中清算進度超前

威廉斯表示，為迎接即將到來的期限，金融業已開始擴大美債現券與附買回交易的集中清算基礎設施，市場活動也比原定時程更早從非集中清算轉向集中清算。
相關改革要求符合資格的美國公債次級市場交易，以及附買回與反向附買回協議，必須透過集中交易對手進行清算，藉此降低交易對手風險，並強化全球最大公債市場的韌性。
威廉斯也重申，Fed目前維持「充裕」銀行準備金的運作架構，已有效確保市場利率維持在聯邦基金利率目標區間內，並支持金融市場正常運作。他強調，Fed承諾提供具彈性的準備金供給；如果監管、市場結構或其他因素導致準備金需求改變，Fed將隨時間調整供給加以配合。
2008年金融危機後，Fed採取充裕準備金架構，確保銀行體系擁有足夠現金，以滿足監管及交易結算需求。Fed去年底停止縮減資產負債表，並開始進行準備金管理購債，以把銀行準備金維持在期望的充裕水準。
paras_en: Boston Fed President Susan Collins and New York Fed President John Williams on Tuesday (the 22nd) each issued fresh signals on interest‑rate policy and reforms to the US Treasury market. Collins said she supports the Fed’s one‑basis‑point hike last week and expects another hike could come before year‑end; Williams noted that the shift of Treasury and repo trades to central clearing is progressing faster than expected, and the Fed will keep bank reserves ample and flexible to ensure smooth market functioning.

Fed officials last week unanimously voted to raise the policy rate by one basis point, marking the first hike since 2023. The latest economic forecasts show growing support among policymakers for further tightening, with 16 officials expecting at least one more hike this year and the median projection calling for another one‑basis‑point increase by year‑end.

Collins backs another rate hike before year‑end. In a LinkedIn post on Tuesday, she said a modest increase in the federal‑funds rate ceiling would help keep inflation on track to return to the Fed’s 2% target. With a strengthening labor market, monetary policy can focus more on restoring price stability, especially as US inflation has been above target for five and a half years.

Although she does not vote on policy this year, Collins warned that the odds of inflation staying “significantly above 2%” are rising. In an interview with the Associated Press on Monday, she said she is among the officials who expect a second hike before year‑end and projects rates to stay unchanged through 2027.

Fed Chair Jerome Powell again did not provide a rate forecast last week. He said the latest hike removes “a slice of accommodation” from the economy, showing the Fed’s intent to further curb inflation pressures while keeping the labor market robust.
Williams did not comment on monetary policy on Tuesday, focusing instead on the structure of the US Treasury market and the supply of bank reserves.

Williams said that, ahead of upcoming deadlines, the financial sector has begun expanding the central‑clearing infrastructure for Treasury cash and repo trades, and market activity has shifted to central clearing earlier than originally scheduled.

The reforms require that eligible secondary‑market Treasury trades, as well as repo and reverse‑repo agreements, be cleared through a central counterparty, reducing counterparty risk and bolstering the resilience of the world’s largest sovereign‑debt market.

Williams also reiterated that the Fed’s current “ample” reserve framework has effectively kept market rates within the federal‑funds target range and supported normal market operations. He emphasized the Fed’s commitment to flexible reserve provision and said the supply will be adjusted over time if regulatory, market‑structure or other factors change reserve demand.

After the 2008 financial crisis, the Fed adopted an ample‑reserves framework to ensure banks have enough cash to meet regulatory and settlement needs. The Fed stopped shrinking its balance sheet at the end of last year and began reserve‑management bond purchases to keep bank reserves at the desired ample level.

items.title: 今後AI在美國改叫「超級智慧」！川普：將鼓勵發展  而非限制
items.title_en: Future U.S. AI Will Be Called “Super Intelligence”! Trump: Will Encourage Development, Not Restrict It
paras: 美國總統川普週二(22日)在聯合國大會上演講時表示，美國政府文件今後將使用「超級智慧」(super intelligence)取代「人工智慧」(artificial intelligence)，並重申他先前關於「人工智慧警告純屬騙局」的說法。
川普說：「從現在起，美國的所有文件，也希望全世界的文件，都將改用『超級(super)』這一更準確的術語，而不是『人工』”(artificial)。所以，它叫『超級智慧』。」
川普還表示，他反對任何試圖控制超級智慧的全球性「圖謀」，並稱「我不會扼殺一種將比工業革命規模更大的事物的發展」。
川普週一(21日)曾稱必要時，美國司法部(DOJ)將介入約束AI風險，但他不會因此阻礙產業發展，強調美國必須維持對中國及其他國家的領先優勢。
川普主張美國應維持AI發展速度，以確保科技競爭力，並持續將AI發展與美中科技競爭連結，並反對因安全疑慮大幅放慢美國AI產業進程。他近日更宣布規劃成立新的「AI Force」，希望統籌美國AI發展與監管政策，同時維持美國在全球AI競爭中的領先地位。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Tuesday (the 22nd) at the United Nations General Assembly that U.S. government documents will henceforth use the term “super intelligence” instead of “artificial intelligence,” and he reiterated his earlier claim that warnings about artificial intelligence are “pure scams.”
Trump said, “From now on, all U.S. documents—and we hope all documents worldwide—will switch to the more accurate term ‘super’ rather than ‘artificial.’ So it will be called ‘super intelligence.’”

Trump also said he opposes any global “plot” to try to control super intelligence, adding, “I will not choke off the development of something that will be larger in scale than the Industrial Revolution.”

On Monday (the 21st), Trump said that, if necessary, the Department of Justice would step in to curb AI risks, but he would not let that hinder industry growth, emphasizing that the United States must maintain its leading edge over China and other countries.

Trump argues the U.S. should keep the pace of AI development to ensure technological competitiveness, continuously linking AI progress to the U.S.-China tech rivalry, and opposing a major slowdown of the American AI sector over safety concerns. He recently announced plans to create a new “AI Force” to coordinate U.S. AI development and regulatory policy while preserving America’s lead in the global AI race.

items.title: 當算力瓶頸變成電力瓶頸！大摩點名缺電這些「缺電概念股」迎暴增商機
items.title_en: When Computing Power Bottlenecks Turn Into Electricity Bottlenecks! Morgan Stanley Flags These “Power‑Shortage” Stocks for Explosive Opportunities
paras: 隨著運算能力與資料中心容量需求暴增，最新分析顯示，美國電網應對這波負載的能力可能比業界原先預期更不足，但也帶來潛在的投資機會。
摩根士丹利(Morgan Stanley)分析師Stephen Byrd周一(21日)預測，截至2028年，美國電力短缺將達33GW，相當於晶片需求的34%。不過這項估算未納入「供電所需時間」(time-to-power)解決方案，例如不依賴電網、可避開電網接入延遲的離網供電。

「有電的資料中心」成稀有資源

Byrd表示，儘管美國潛在電力缺口規模龐大，但也蘊藏可觀的投資機會。他認為能於這波電力供需失衡中受益的其中一類企業，是「有電外殼」(powered shell)供應商，也就是能重新利用既有電力與電網資源、將其改造成資料中心的企業。
Byrd推薦Cipher Digital(CIFR-US)、Hut 8(HUT-US)、Riot Platforms(RIOT-US)、Galaxy Digital(GLXY-US)及Terawulf(WULF-US)，並預期這些公司各自在未來六個月內至少簽署一筆大型資料中心租賃合約。
Freedom Capital Markets分析師Paul Meeks也表示，電力供需缺口「已經很大」，如果電力進一步短缺，情況可能「變得非常嚴峻」。這種情況可能推升Cipher Digital、Terawulf及Hut 8等公司的股價，因為這些企業已取得資料中心所需的電力協議。

「表後電力」需求升溫　發電設備商迎商機

Byrd表示，另一個值得關注的投資領域是發電設備。
他預期市場對「表後」或「用戶端」(behind-the-meter，BTM)發電將激增，使發電設備的需求出現「大幅成長」。這類供電方式讓資料中心等高耗能設施可以在現場儲存或取得電力，不必完全依賴公共電網。
Byrd推薦Bloom Energy(BE-US)、GE Vernova(GEV-US)及Cummins(CMI-US)。
他預期，未來幾個月將出現多筆「表後」發電交易，尤其是在德州西部。
此外，參與「表後」系統開發的企業，也可望與資料中心開發商及AI公司展開大量交易，例如Solaris Energy Infrastructure(SEI-US)及Vistra(VST-US)。

SpaceX另闢天然氣渦輪機戰場

SpaceX(SPCX-US)也可能因電力短缺受惠，但原因鮮為人知：該公司已進軍燃氣渦輪機領域。Byrd指出，SpaceX今年稍早收購電力供應商APR Energy，這是一家生產可移動式燃氣渦輪機及發電廠的公司。
Byrd說：「SpaceX一向會鎖定最限制規模擴張的因素並加以突破。隨著該公司在運算時間與供電成本方面建立護城河，它似乎已找到下一個目標：渦輪機葉片與導葉。」
paras_en: As computing power and data‑center capacity needs surge, the latest analysis shows the U.S. power grid may be less able to handle the load than the industry originally expected, but it also creates potential investment opportunities.

Morgan Stanley analyst Stephen Byrd forecast on Monday (the 21st) that by 2028 the United States will face a 33 GW electricity shortfall, roughly 34% of the chip demand. The estimate, however, does not factor in “time‑to‑power” solutions that avoid grid reliance and bypass grid‑connection delays, such as off‑grid power.

“Powered data centers” become a scarce resource. Byrd said that despite the massive potential power gap in the U.S., there are sizable investment opportunities. He believes one class of beneficiaries are “powered‑shell” providers – companies that can repurpose existing electricity and grid assets into data‑center facilities.

Byrd recommends Cipher Digital (CIFR‑US), Hut 8 (HUT‑US), Riot Platforms (RIOT‑US), Galaxy Digital (GLXY‑US) and Terawulf (WULF‑US), expecting each to sign at least one large data‑center lease within the next six months.

Freedom Capital Markets analyst Paul Meeks also noted the power supply‑demand gap is already huge, and further shortages could make the situation “very severe.” That could lift the stock prices of Cipher Digital, Terawulf, Hut 8 and similar firms that have already secured power agreements for data‑centers.
“Behind‑the‑meter” power demand heats up, creating opportunities for power‑equipment makers. Byrd highlighted another attractive investment area: power‑generation equipment.

He expects a surge in demand for “behind‑the‑meter” (BTM) generation, driving “significant growth” in equipment sales. This supply model lets high‑consumption facilities such as data centers store or obtain power on site without relying entirely on the public grid.
Byrd recommends Bloom Energy (BE‑US), GE Vernova (GEV‑US) and Cummins (CMI‑US).
He predicts multiple BTM generation deals will materialize in the coming months, especially in West Texas.
In addition, companies developing BTM systems could see large transactions with data‑center developers and AI firms, such as Solaris Energy Infrastructure (SEI‑US) and Vistra (VST‑US).

SpaceX opens a natural‑gas turbine battlefield. SpaceX (SPCX‑US) may also benefit from power shortages, though the reason is less known: the company has entered the gas‑turbine arena. Byrd noted SpaceX earlier this year acquired power‑supplier APR Energy, which builds mobile gas turbines and power plants.

Byrd said, “SpaceX always targets the factor that most limits scale‑up and breaks through it. As the company builds a moat around compute time and power‑costs, it appears to have found its next target: turbine blades and guide vanes.”

items.title: 〈台幣〉交投熱絡處續強格局 升值5分收31.708元
items.title_en: New Taiwan Dollar Keeps Strong Appreciation Trend, Gains 0.05 to Close at 31.708
paras: 新台幣今(22)日維持續強升值格局，終場收在31.708元，升值5分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值達20.13億美元相對大量區。
新台幣今日以31.74元、升值1.8分開出後，最高來到31.658元，全日均處升值態勢，高低價差9分。
觀察主要亞幣，韓元續強升值達0.8%，新台幣收升0.16%，星元和人民幣則貶0.05%左右，日元和泰銖續挫逾0.2%，美元指數反彈達0.15%。
元大投顧表示，隨著國際原油、債券殖利率回落，市場風險偏好轉強，帶動科技族群走揚。
國泰證期研究部也說明，中東局勢雖因青年運動攻擊沙國而緊張，但川普釋出與伊朗會面意願，油價回落且 10 年期美債殖利率降至 4.951%、30 年期降至 5.284%，加上美國財長貝森特已會晤何立峰，為即將登場的川習會鋪路，舒緩市場對通膨升息及地緣政治的疑慮。
paras_en: The New Taiwan dollar maintained its strong appreciation trend today (22nd), closing at 31.708, up 0.05, with Taipei foreign‑exchange brokerage firms’ transaction volume reaching US$2.013 billion in the large‑volume segment.
The New Taiwan dollar opened at 31.74, up 0.018, then rose to a high of 31.658, staying in appreciation throughout the day, with a high‑low spread of 0.09.

Among major Asian currencies, the Korean won continued to appreciate by 0.8%, the New Taiwan dollar rose 0.16%, the Singapore dollar and the Chinese yuan each weakened about 0.05%, the Japanese yen and Thai baht each fell more than 0.2%, and the U.S. dollar index rebounded 0.15%.
Yuanta Investment Advisory said that as international crude‑oil prices and bond yields retreat, market risk appetite strengthens, boosting the technology sector.

Cathay Securities Research explained that although Middle‑East tensions have risen due to a youth‑movement attack on Saudi Arabia, President Trump signaled willingness to meet Iran, oil prices have fallen and the 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield has dropped to 4.951% and the 30‑year to 5.284%. In addition, U.S. Treasury Secretary Besson has met with He Lifeng, paving the way for the upcoming Trump‑Xi summit and easing market concerns about inflation‑driven rate hikes and geopolitical risks.

items.title: 油價回落與半導體出口強勁 韓元大漲1.5%領跑亞幣
items.title_en: Oil price drop and strong semiconductor exports, Won jumps 1.5% leading Asian currencies
paras: 受到國際油價急跌、南韓出口數據強勁及外資湧入等多重利多帶動，韓元兌美元匯率周二(22日)顯著走揚，韓元單日漲幅一度擴大至1.5%，來到1,352.90韓元兌1美元，創下五周以來最大單日升幅，表現大幅跑贏其他亞洲貨幣。
市場數據顯示，韓元兌美元當日開盤報1,371韓元，較前一交易日收盤價升約0.67%。隨後匯率迅速突破1,360韓元關卡。分析人士指出，適逢中秋假期臨近，南韓主要出口企業集中拋售美元，加上外資大舉買入南韓股票與美股強勁反彈，帶動整體市場風險偏好回溫。
國際局勢方面，美伊局勢出現對話跡象，國際油價連續3日下挫，布蘭特原油期貨下跌3.4%至每桶100.34美元，西德州原油(WTI)亦重挫4.5%跌破100美元關卡，帶來股市及韓元匯市利多。
南韓周一公布9月前20天出口額年增高達78%，其中半導體出貨大幅激增259%，帶來龐大的美元資金流入。此外，美元買盤減弱，美國10年期國債殖利率回落至5%以下，緩解了美元的升值壓力。
友利銀行(Woori Bank)分析師閔庚源表示，風險偏好回升有利於出口商結匯拋售美元，進一步拉低匯率。然而，全球高利率環境與美元整體強勢，仍可能是限制韓元後續升值空間的潛在因素。
paras_en: Benefiting from a sharp fall in international oil prices, robust South Korean export data and inflows of foreign capital, the Korean won surged significantly against the US dollar on Tuesday (the 22nd). The one‑day gain briefly widened to 1.5%, reaching 1,352.90 won per dollar, marking the largest single‑day rise in five weeks and far outpacing other Asian currencies.

Market data showed the won opened at 1,371 per dollar, about 0.67% higher than the previous close. The rate then quickly broke the 1,360‑won barrier. Analysts noted that with the Mid‑Autumn holiday approaching, major South Korean exporters were selling dollars en masse, while foreign investors were buying South Korean stocks and US equities rebounded strongly, boosting overall market risk appetite.

On the geopolitical front, signs of dialogue emerged between the US and Iran, and international oil prices fell for three consecutive days. Brent crude futures dropped 3.4% to $100.34 a barrel, and West Texas Intermediate slid 4.5% below the $100 mark, providing a boost to both equity markets and the won exchange market.

South Korea reported on Monday that export value for the first 20 days of September rose 78% year‑on‑year, with semiconductor shipments surging 259%, bringing in a massive inflow of US dollars. At the same time, dollar buying pressure eased and the yield on the US 10‑year Treasury fell below 5%, relieving upward pressure on the dollar.

Woori Bank analyst Min Gyeong‑won said that the revival of risk appetite benefits exporters who convert earnings and sell dollars, further pushing the won lower. However, the global high‑interest‑rate environment and the overall strength of the dollar could still limit the won’s upside potential.

paras: 美元周一(19日)小幅走升，來到近8周高點，延續上周強勁漲勢，此前聯準會(Fed)進行了 3年多來首次升息。另一方面，日元在日本銀行(BoJ)決定收緊貨幣政策後，先前一波猛烈跌勢暫歇，歐元則因德國最新民調結果出爐而受矚。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.2%，報100.43，創7月29日以來最高。
本月市場最受關注議題之一，就是各大央行的升息行動。歐洲銀行(ECB)、聯準會與日本銀行近期都採取升息措施，且都提到了能源價格推動的通膨壓力。
聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)上周在記者會上表示，「明確的事實就是通膨太高，而且已經持續太久。」
此前，聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)一致投票決定，將聯邦資金利率從3.50%-3.75%上調至 3.75%-4.00%。
此外，聯準會更新後的「經濟預測摘要」顯示，至少有12名FOMC委員認為今年還會再升息一次。
在FOMC做出升息決定之前，市場對聯準會升息的預期機率曾飆升至90%。推動市場預期的因素包括：油價急升、美國經濟數據，以及債券市場持續遭到拋售。尤其是固定收益市場投資人對這次升息反應正面，因他們認為這顯示聯準會沒有在通膨問題上落後於形勢。
Northwestern Mutual Wealth Management投資長Brent Schutte表示，「經濟的強勁表現，很可能就是聯準會認為可以升息的原因。但我們也提醒，升息的目的就是要放慢經濟成長速度。因此也會提高政策過度緊縮的風險，因為升息對經濟的影響延遲且不均。」
他進一步表示，「你們或許還記得，聯準會上一輪在2022年和2023年的升息，造成了經濟出現明顯分化。」當時，對利率較敏感的產業、企業及消費者面臨較大壓力，即使整體經濟仍持續成長。
歐元承受德國政治局勢轉變壓力
歐元兌美元下跌0.2%，至1歐元兌1.1463 美元。
歐洲交易市場正在消化周末公布的選舉預測結果。結果顯示，極右翼政黨「德國另類選擇黨」(AfD)在德國東北部的州選舉中取得領先。
這項具歷史意義的結果，直接打擊了德國總理梅爾茨(Friedrich Merz)領導的主流保守派聯盟，也讓歐洲股市面臨新的政治風險。
德銀的Jim Reid表示，「在極右派方面，AfD持續獲得更多支持，主要訴求包括反移民與反建制，尤其是在德國東部地區。」他也指出，左派政黨似乎則成功利用了民眾對住房負擔能力、生活成本以及社會不平等的擔憂。
他補充，「對市場而言，眼前最直接的影響並不是德國國家政策會立刻改變，而是德國政治中心進一步弱化，也再次提醒市場，推動歐洲政治兩極化的力量仍然存在。」
日元在升息、「利率檢查」後走弱
日元周一走弱，延續上周約2%猛烈跌勢。此前日銀公布利率決策後，日元跌至數周低點。
美元兌日元上漲0.3%，來到157.36日元。
日本金融市場周一因三天國定假期而休市。
由於假期期間流動性較低，全球交易員高度警戒日本政府可能進行外匯干預。過去在市場流動性不足的情況下，央行進場買進本國貨幣可能造成更大的價格波動。
讓市場對干預的擔憂進一步升高的是，《日本經濟新聞》上周五報導，日銀曾進行所謂的 「利率檢查」。這是指央行官員打電話給外匯交易部門，詢問市場上實際的買賣價。
日本銀行上周五將借貸成本提高至1.25%，創下31年來最高水準。
然而，兩名委員投下偏寬鬆政策的反對票，加上日銀總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)強調政策需要進行預先性的調整，最初反而引發市場「利多出盡」反應。
這也迫使日本當局開始採取更積極的口頭警告及「利率檢查」，以支撐日元匯率。

paras_en: The dollar edged higher on Monday (the 19th), reaching a near‑8‑week high and continuing last week’s strong rally after the Federal Reserve delivered its first rate hike in more than three years. Meanwhile, the yen’s sharp slide eased after the Bank of Japan tightened policy, and the euro drew attention following the release of Germany’s latest poll results.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.2% to 100.43, its highest level since July 29.

One of the market’s top topics this month is the rate‑hike actions of major central banks. The European Central Bank, the Federal Reserve and the Bank of Japan have all recently raised rates and all cited inflation pressure from energy prices.
Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh said at a press conference last week that “the clear fact is that inflation is too high and has been too persistent.”
Earlier, the Federal Open Market Committee voted unanimously to lift the federal funds rate range from 3.50‑3.75% to 3.75‑4.00%.
In addition, the Fed’s updated Summary of Economic Projections showed that at least 12 FOMC members expect another rate hike this year.

Before the FOMC’s decision, market expectations for a Fed hike had surged to 90%. Drivers of that expectation included a sharp rise in oil prices, U.S. economic data and continued bond‑market selling. Fixed‑income investors reacted positively, seeing the hike as evidence that the Fed is not lagging behind inflation pressures.

Brent Schutte, Chief Investment Officer at Northwestern Mutual Wealth Management, said, “The economy’s strong performance is likely why the Fed feels it can raise rates. But we remind that the purpose of tightening is to slow growth, which raises the risk of overtightening because the impact of rate hikes is delayed and uneven.”

He added, “You may recall the Fed’s previous tightening cycles in 2022‑2023 caused a clear split in the economy.” At that time, rate‑sensitive industries, firms and consumers felt heightened pressure even as overall growth continued.
Euro Under Pressure From Shifts in German Politics
The euro fell 0.2% against the dollar to $1.1463 per euro.
European markets are digesting the election‑forecast results released over the weekend, which showed the far‑right Alternative for Germany (AfD) leading in state elections in Germany’s northeast.
The historic outcome directly hit the mainstream conservative Union bloc led by Chancellor Friedrich Merz and added new political risk to European equities.

Jim Reid of Deutsche Bank said, “On the far‑right, the AfD is gaining more support, driven mainly by anti‑immigration and anti‑establishment messages, especially in eastern Germany.” He also noted that left‑wing parties seem to be capitalising on public concerns about housing affordability, living costs and social inequality.

He added, “For markets, the most immediate impact isn’t an immediate change in German national policy, but a further weakening of Germany’s political centre, reminding investors that forces driving European political polarisation remain present.”
Yen Weakens After Rate Hike and “Rate Check”
The yen weakened on Monday, extending last week’s roughly 2% plunge. Earlier, the yen fell to a multi‑week low after the BOJ announced its rate decision.
The dollar rose 0.3% against the yen to 157.36 yen.
Japan’s financial markets were closed on Monday for a three‑day national holiday.

Because liquidity is thin during the holiday, global traders are on high alert for possible foreign‑exchange intervention by the Japanese government. In past low‑liquidity episodes, central‑bank purchases of the domestic currency have amplified price swings.

Market worries about intervention were heightened after Nikkei reported last Friday that the BOJ had carried out a so‑called “rate check,” meaning officials called FX desks to ask about actual bid‑ask prices in the market.
The Bank of Japan raised its borrowing cost to 1.25% last Friday, the highest level in 31 years.

However, two board members cast votes for a more accommodative stance, and Governor Kazuo Ueda stressed that policy needed a pre‑emptive adjustment, initially prompting a “no‑more‑good‑news” reaction in the market.
That forced Japanese authorities to adopt more aggressive verbal warnings and conduct “rate checks” to support the yen’s exchange rate.
