items.title: 日本救日元反成賣點！瑞銀資管等再度干預伺機賣出
items.title_en: Japan's Yen Rescue Becomes a Selling Point! UBS Asset Management and Others May Intervene Again to Sell
paras: 瑞銀資產管理(UBS Asset Management)全球主權與貨幣固定收益主管Kevin Zhao表示，若日本政府再度出手干預匯市、拉抬日元，將是賣出日元的好機會。他並不認為日銀上周五升息，意味貨幣政策已明顯轉向鷹派。
Zhao今年稍早原本加碼持有日元，但在美日兩國7月大規模聯手買進日元後賣出部位，如今正等待下一次進場賣出的時機。當時日元兌美元一度貶至約164日元，創40年來最低水準。
日銀上周升息，並宣告貨幣政策已進入「新階段」，但Zhao認為，無論是進一步升息或政府再次干預，都不足以讓投資人相信日元能夠持續走強。他直言，日本維持弱勢日元的根本政策並未改變，美元兌日元接下來可能繼續攀升，日本當局最終仍會再度干預，否則恐怕顏面盡失。
日元本月初一度因市場預期日銀將加快升息而反彈，但上周五升息後支撐有限，匯價再度朝164日元關卡靠近。日本當局隨後向市場參與者進行匯率「詢價」，這項行動通常被視為正式進場買進日元的前兆。
目前交易員押注日銀至明年6月最多還會升息3次，但也預期聯準會(Fed)同期將升息相同次數，意味美日利差未必明顯縮小。Zhao反問，若Fed降息期間美元兌日元都未能大幅回落，如今Fed轉向升息，日元又怎麼可能顯著升值？
Zhao預期，即使日本通膨隨經濟成長升溫，日銀未來幾個月仍會放慢緊縮腳步。日本首相高市早苗延續前首相安倍晉三的「安倍經濟學」路線，堅持透過財政支出支撐經濟。在股市大漲、名目國內生產毛額(GDP)成長及政府債務龐大的情況下，低利率仍符合政府與日銀利益。他強調，「安倍經濟學從來不等於強勢日元」。
paras_en: UBS Asset Management’s global sovereign and currency fixed‑income head Kevin Zhao said that if the Japanese government intervenes again in the FX market to prop up the yen, it would be a good opportunity to sell the yen. He does not believe that the Bank of Japan’s rate hike last Friday signals a clear hawkish shift in monetary policy.

Zhao had increased his yen holdings earlier this year, but sold those positions after the United States and Japan jointly bought large amounts of yen in July. He is now waiting for the next chance to re‑enter and sell. At that time the yen fell to about ¥164 per dollar, its lowest level in 40 years.

The BOJ raised rates last week and announced that monetary policy had entered a “new stage,” but Zhao thinks that whether the BOJ hikes further or the government intervenes again, neither will convince investors that the yen can stay strong. He bluntly says Japan’s fundamental policy of keeping a weak yen has not changed, the dollar‑yen pair may keep climbing, and the authorities will eventually intervene again or risk losing face.

The yen briefly rebounded earlier this month on expectations that the BOJ would accelerate rate hikes, but the support faded after the Friday hike and the exchange rate moved back toward the ¥164 level. Japanese authorities then sent a “price inquiry” to market participants, an action usually seen as a prelude to officially buying yen.

Traders currently bet that the BOJ may raise rates up to three more times by June next year, while also expecting the Fed to raise rates the same number of times, meaning the US‑Japan rate differential may not narrow much. Zhao retorts that if the dollar‑yen pair did not fall significantly during the Fed’s rate‑cut cycle, how could the yen appreciate markedly now that the Fed is back to tightening?

Zhao expects that even if Japanese inflation rises with economic growth, the BOJ will slow its tightening over the next few months. Prime Minister Kishida continues former Prime Minister Abe’s “Abenomics” approach, insisting on fiscal spending to support the economy. With a booming stock market, nominal GDP growth and massive government debt, low rates still suit both the government and the BOJ. He stresses that “Abenomics has never meant a strong yen.”

items.title: 南韓央行啟動24小時韓元交割網路試點
items.title_en: South Korea's Central Bank Launches 24-Hour Won Settlement Network Pilot
paras: 南韓中央銀行(BOK)周一(21日)正式啟動首個24小時韓元交割網路的試營運。此系統於當地時間周一上午9點開始運行，首波由國民銀行(KB Kookmin)、友利銀行(Woori)、韓亞銀行(Hana)與新韓銀行(Shinhan)等四家南韓本土商業銀行率先參與。
在開運首晨約9點30分，兩家參試本土機構成功完成首筆測試交易，金額約為14億韓元(約合100萬美元)。
這項全天候交割機制在工作日實行24小時不間斷運作，僅在周末與國定假日休市。其最大特色在於允許境外外國投資人透過「韓元業務註冊外國機構」(RFI-K)開設的帳戶，在其所在地的當地營業時間直接辦理韓元交易結算與交割，無須親自在南韓境內金融機構開立帳戶。
此舉顯著改善了過去歐美投資人因時差問題而面臨的債券與資產交割延宕困境。
此次試營運為南韓政府推動「韓元國際化路線圖」及外匯改革計畫的重要推手。先前南韓在岸韓元對美元外匯市場已於7月邁入全天候交易，本次交割網路補足了配套支付基礎設施，旨在提升韓元的國際地位，並積極爭取納入 MSCI 發達市場指數。
這一網路預計經約3個月測試後，於2027年1月正式上線營運，屆時將擴大邀請全球主要外資銀行及金融機構全面接入。
paras_en: South Korea's central bank (BOK) officially launched the pilot operation of its first 24‑hour won settlement network on Monday (the 21st). The system began running at 9:00 a.m. local time, with four domestic commercial banks – KB Kookmin, Woori, Hana and Shinhan – participating in the initial wave.

Around 9:30 a.m. on the first morning of operation, two of the participating domestic institutions successfully completed the first test transaction, amounting to roughly 1.4 billion won (about US$1 million).

The round‑the‑clock settlement mechanism operates continuously 24 hours on business days, closing only on weekends and public holidays. Its key feature is that foreign investors can settle and deliver won transactions directly during their own local business hours through accounts opened via the "Registered Foreign Institution for Won Business" (RFI‑K), without needing to open an account at a Korean financial institution.
This move markedly eases the bond and asset settlement delays that European and U.S. investors previously faced due to time‑zone differences.

The pilot supports South Korea's government push for a "Won Internationalisation Roadmap" and foreign‑exchange reform, following the launch of all‑day on‑shore won‑USD trading in July. The new settlement network adds the necessary payment infrastructure to boost the won's global standing and to help secure inclusion in the MSCI Developed Markets index.

The network is expected to undergo about three months of testing before going live in January 2027, at which point it will invite major global foreign banks and financial institutions to connect fully.

items.title: 〈台幣〉風險情緒轉強 升值5分收31.758元
items.title_en: NTD risk sentiment turns strong, gains 0.05 and closes at 31.758
paras: 新台幣今(21)日全日維持偏強走勢，終場收在31.758元，升值5分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值擴大至22.67億美元。
新台幣今日以31.79元、升值1.8分開出後，最高來到31.716元，全日高低價差7.4分。
觀察主要亞幣，韓元飆升超過1%，新台幣收升0.16%，泰銖升逾0.1%，人民幣升值0.05%上下，星元在平盤附近狹幅震盪，日元則逆勢貶近0.2%，美元指數小跌0.05%左右。
元大投顧認為，聯準會通過升息 1 碼將目標區調高至 3.75%到 4%，也是 2023 年 7 月來首次升息，但聯準會主席華許表示經濟依然強勁，可在不損害就業市場下恢復物價穩定，因此，台股在各項變數漸漸釐清後，可望展開季底作帳行情，惟個股將強弱分明。
統一投顧則指出，上周全球央行周和美日升息後，美國10年債殖利率止漲，緩和通膨擔憂和繼續升息的緊張情緒，而儘管中東地緣政治局勢動盪、國際債市與匯市波動加劇、AI 放緩雜音增多，但整體風險可控，再考量美伊再次出現重啟談判曙光，可提振市場風險偏好。
paras_en: The New Taiwan dollar stayed on the stronger side throughout the day on the 21st, ending at NT$31.758, a gain of 0.05, with the turnover at Taipei foreign‑exchange brokers expanding to US$2.267 billion.
After opening at NT$31.79, up 0.018, the NTD peaked at NT$31.716, with a daily high‑low range of 0.074.

Among the major Asian currencies, the Korean won surged more than 1%, the NTD rose 0.16%, the Thai baht gained over 0.1%, the Chinese yuan appreciated about 0.05%, the Singapore dollar hovered near flat, the Japanese yen fell about 0.2% against the trend, and the US dollar index slipped roughly 0.05%.

Yuanta Securities believes that the Fed’s 1‑percentage‑point rate hike, raising the target range to 3.75%‑4%, marks the first increase since July 2023. Fed Chair Jerome Powell said the economy remains strong and price stability can be restored without harming the labor market, so after variables are clarified, Taiwan’s stock market could see end‑of‑quarter accounting activity, though individual stocks will show clear winners and losers.

Unified Securities notes that after last week’s global central‑bank meetings and US‑Japan rate hikes, the US 10‑year Treasury yield stalled, easing inflation concerns and the tension over further hikes. Despite geopolitical turbulence in the Middle East, heightened volatility in international bond and FX markets, and growing noise around a slowdown in AI, overall risk remains manageable. Moreover, renewed hopes of renewed US‑Iran talks could boost market risk appetite.

items.title: 升息失望與干預疑慮交織 日元在連假流動性低迷下恐加劇波動
items.title_en: Rate Hike Disappointment and Intervention Concerns Intertwine, Yen May See Heightened Volatility Amid Low Liquidity During Holiday
paras: 日元對美元在上周重挫逾2%後，於周一(21日)盤初暫告企穩，報156.85日元兌1美元。然而，隨著日本「白銀周」到來，交易員擔心，在市場流動性大幅下降後，恐加劇匯率波動。
日本央行上周五雖然將政策利率調升至1.25%，創下31年來新高，然而會中出現2票反對，加上總裁植田和男並未提供明確的未來升息指引，使寄望鷹派立場的投資人感到失望，引發日元走跌，盤中一度下挫1.3%。
隨後市場傳出日本官方進行「匯率檢查」(rate check)，雖稍微收斂跌幅並收於156.88日元，但依然凸顯出匯市強烈的干預疑慮與風險。
目前，日本正逢「白銀周」連續休假，市場交易流動性大幅下降，投資人對官方干預保持高度戒備。分析指出，流動性較低時易引發劇烈波動，但也為當局介入提供放大效果的契機，一如今年4月至5月黃金周期間日元跌破160關卡後的干預舉措。
財務省數據顯示，日本當局於7月下旬至8月26日期間，曾砸下創紀錄的15.4兆日元進行美日協調干預，帶動日元從7月接近164的40年低點，一度強勢反彈至9月初的152.89高峰。
然而，美日央行政策分歧再次為日元帶來下行壓力。聯準會近期發出鷹派訊號，市場預計10月繼續升息的機率升至55%；反觀日央行10月升息的機率，已被掉期市場定價降至20%以下。
監管數據顯示，投機客在日央行會前將日元淨多頭部位推升至97億美元(創2025年7月以來新高)。但在日央行政策指引缺乏明確鷹派訊號的情況下，這批多頭押注正面臨極大回檔風險。
paras_en: The yen slipped more than 2% against the dollar last week, but on Monday (the 21st) it briefly steadied in early trade at 156.85 yen per $1.

Although the Bank of Japan raised its policy rate to 1.25% last Friday – a 31‑year high – two votes were cast against the move and Governor Kazuo Ueda gave no clear guidance on future hikes, leaving investors who had hoped for a hawkish stance disappointed and sending the yen down, at one point falling 1.3% intraday.

Subsequently, reports emerged that Japanese authorities were conducting a “rate check,” which trimmed the decline slightly and closed at 156.88 yen, but the episode still underscored strong market fears of possible intervention.

Japan is currently in the middle of “Silver Week,” a string of holidays that has sharply reduced market liquidity, prompting investors to stay on high alert for official action. Analysts note that low‑liquidity environments can trigger sharp moves, yet they also give authorities a bigger impact if they choose to step in, as seen after the yen fell below the 160‑yen barrier during the gold‑price rally in April‑May this year.

Ministry of Finance data show that Japanese authorities intervened with a record‑breaking 15.4 trillion yen in coordinated US‑Japan action from late July to August 26, lifting the yen from near a 40‑year low of about 164 in July to a strong rebound of 152.89 in early September.

However, policy divergence between the Fed and the BOJ is again weighing on the yen. The Fed’s recent hawkish signals have pushed the market’s odds of another October hike to 55%, while the BOJ’s chance of an October hike has been priced by the swap market at below 20%.

Regulatory data indicate that speculators pushed net long positions on the yen to $9.7 billion ahead of the BOJ meeting – a high not seen since July 2025 – but with the BOJ offering no clear hawkish guidance, those long bets now face a substantial risk of a sharp unwind.
